Job Description

Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to building exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new insights can come from everywhere, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world.
 

The Opportunity

Structured Content is at the heart of the engines powering the new age Experiences such as Chatbots, Voice Based Devices, Fluid and Omni-Channel content delivery. In Technical Communication group of Adobe, we are developing a new age Component Content Management System which powers the journey of Structured Content for large enterprises. Scale and efficiency are key here. Millions of documents are published regularly to multiple platforms and channels across the industry using this solution. We have a strong vision and we are looking for a highly motivated, technically driven and hands on leader to realize it for our product.
 

About the Team:

AEM Guides is a new age technology CCMS. It is used by Fortune-500 companies which publish millions of documents regularly using this product. It is a unique opportunity to work in a startup like environment within a large organization where all product functions collaborate closely with the business counterparts and with the large enterprise customers. Given the enterprise business domain and the startup nature of the team, we are growing fast and scaling the product scope and customer base at a very rapid pace.
 

The Challenge

As a Senior Computer Scientist, you will go beyond traditional coding responsibilities to lead and shape complex features within our systems. Your role will focus on:

Architecting Scalable Solutions: Design and implement features that integrate seamlessly with our broader system architecture, leveraging Adobe Experience Manager capabilities to manage customer workflows, and drive actionable insights.

Complex Systems Integration: Ensure that new features interact effectively with existing components, maintaining high performance and reliability.

Advanced Algorithmic Design: Develop and optimize algorithms to solve complex problems, applying sophisticated design principles to enhance system functionality.

Strategic Design Judgment: Make informed, high-level design decisions that align with long-term product goals and architectural standards.

Product and Technology Expertise: Stay ahead of the emerging technologies, using this knowledge to drive innovation and continuously improve our offerings.

We are looking for passionate and driven senior architects who can translate intricate product features into scalable, efficient solutions. Your expertise in architectural decision-making and team mentoring will be crucial to our success and innovation in the marketing technology space.
 

Roles & Responsibilities:

This is an individual contributor position. Expectations will be on the below lines:

Responsible for design and architecture of new services and features

Well versed in emerging industry technologies and trends, and the ability to channel that knowledge to the team and use it to influence product direction.

Be responsible for all phases of engineering. From early specs, design/architecture, technology choice, development, unit-testing/integration automation, and deployment.

Collaborate with architects, product management and other engineering teams to build the services and product features

Build technical specifications, prototypes and presentations to communicate your ideas.

Participate in resolution of production issues and develop solutions to prevent future issues from happening again

Orchestrate with team to develop a product or parts of a large product.
 

Required Skills & Expertise:

5-8 years of experience in technical roles, proven experience across product life cycle.

Should have excellent computer science fundamentals and a good understanding of design, and performance of algorithm.

Experience in scaling and leading teams building solution with cloud technologies

Deep expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks like React.js, Angular and proficient in state management libraries (e.g., Redux, MobX, or Vuex).

Strong knowledge of Node.js, JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript for building scalable applications.

In-depth understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).

Expertise in optimizing frontend performance, including lazy loading, code splitting, and minimizing asset size.

Proficient in tools like Lighthouse, Webpack, and Rollup.

Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and deploying frontend applications.

Proficient in testing frameworks like Jest, Mocha, Cypress, or Puppeteer.

Experience in writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.

Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.

Experience in handling WebSocket and real-time data updates

Experience with server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG)

Ability to build consensus & drive decisions in ambiguous scenarios

Excellent work ethics and highly motivated

Excellent oral and written communication skills (interpersonal and client-facing)

Ability to manage systems development scope and changes in the context of the business environment.

Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
 

Architectural Skills

Scalable Design Patterns:

Ability to design scalable, modular, and maintainable frontend architectures.

Expertise in micro-frontends and component-driven development.

Performance Monitoring:

Familiarity with tools like Adobe Analytics, New Relic, or Sentry to monitor application performance.

Component Libraries:

Experience in designing and maintaining reusable component libraries using tools like Storybook.

Code Reviews & Standards:

Skilled in conducting thorough code reviews and enforcing best practices.

System Design:

Strong understanding of system design principles for large-scale web applications.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer to contribute to the development of a large-scale Windows desktop photo editing application-Adobe Express. The role involves building high-performance features in a complex, multi-process architecture while maintaining strong standards around performance, memory efficiency, and reliability. The ideal candidate will have experience in image editing systems and modern AI-assisted development workflows, and will be comfortable working in a large, evolving codebase.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Development

Design and implement features for a Windows desktop photo editing application with focus on performance, usability, and reliability.

Work within a large codebase to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with long-term product architecture.

Platform & System Engineering

Contribute to development of complex Windows desktop systems involving multi-process architectures and IPC-based communication.

Optimize application performance, memory footprint, and resource utilization across different hardware configurations.

Work with system-level constraints such as rendering pipelines, file handling, and OS integration.

Image Editing Domain

Build and improve image editing capabilities including rendering workflows, editing operations, and UI interactions related to image manipulation.

Ensure high fidelity and responsiveness in editing operations across large images and diverse file formats.

AI-Assisted Development

Leverage generative and agentic AI technologies to improve development efficiency, prototyping speed, and automation.

Build workflows that use AI to accelerate feature development, testing, and debugging while maintaining strong engineering validation standards.

Demonstrate understanding of the strengths and limitations of generative AI tools and apply them responsibly in engineering workflows.

Quality & Engineering Discipline

Maintain high standards for code quality, test coverage, and system stability.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure features meet performance, reliability, and usability expectations.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in software development with strong proficiency in C++ or C# for Windows desktop applications.

Experience working on large codebases with complex architecture.

Hands-on experience building or contributing to image editing or graphics-related applications.

Experience developing Windows desktop applications with understanding of OS-level behaviors and performance considerations.

Experience working with multi-process architectures and IPC-based communication models.

Strong understanding of performance optimization, memory management, and system resource constraints.

Experience using generative AI or agentic development frameworks to improve engineering productivity and accelerate development workflows.

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration + Adobe Creativity & Productivity) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners 

You will collaborate closely with strategists, technologists, data scientists, partner organizations, and field teams to define what “great” looks like—and how Adobe helps Technology companies get there. 

 

2. Sharpen and Coordinate a Global GTM Strategy 

Translate the industry POV into a globally aligned, high-impact GTM motion. 
You will: 

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs 

· Ensure GTM motions scale globally—not tied to a single region, account list, or narrow set of priorities 

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies 

This role ensures Adobe shows up to the Technology industry with one coordinated voice and one unified strategy. 

 

3. Drive Influence Through High-Leverage Thought Leadership 

Focus on fewer, more strategic deliverables that scale across the business. 
This includes: 

· Authoring frameworks, POVs, and industry narratives used across Adobe’s global ecosystem 

· Identifying where Adobe has a differentiated “right to win” in Technology 

· Codifying insights from customer work into reusable global assets, such as customer success stories 

· Monitoring industry trends to ensure Adobe stays ahead of market shifts, emerging business models, and new experience expectations 

The impact of your work will be measured by clarity, adoption, and influence—not volume. 

 

4. Engage Executives Strategically (primarily 1:many, and 1:1 for top priority accounts) 

Represent Adobe as a trusted advisor in Technology executive settings. 
You will: 

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences 

· Support high-value pursuits, Customer Experience Center (CEC) briefings, and strategic account engagements 

· Sponsor and cultivate key customers, enabling case studies, customer keynotes, and repeatable stories of impact 

Your goal is to maximize industry influence at scale while supporting the strategic deals that matter most. 

 

5. Amplify Global Marketing and Upskill the Ecosystem 

Partner with global marketing and field teams to amplify Adobe’s Technology leadership. 

 
You will: 

· Shape global campaigns, messaging, and event strategies 

· Guide positioning for AI-driven innovation in Technology 

· Enable DSG, field teams, SCs, BDRs, and partners with reusable training, demos, and toolkits 

· Build a consistent global drumbeat of Adobe-led thought leadership 

This role turns Adobe’s Technology capabilities into a cohesive, globally recognized story. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Success is defined by the clarity you create, the global alignment you drive, and the measurable impact on Adobe’s Technology business. 

Ideal candidates bring: 

· 10+ years of experience in the Technology sector (software, hardware, cloud, semiconductor, electronics, strategy consulting, or platform provider) 

· Deep understanding of digital transformation within Technology: customer data, AI/ML, personalization, content supply chain, omnichannel experiences, B2B engagement, product-led growth, and measurement 

· Proven success building and executing strategic transformation programs 

· Experience aligning GTM strategies across sales, product, and partner teams, ideally with global scope 

· Ability to distill complex topics into clear, scalable frameworks and POVs 

· Outstanding executive presence with extensive experience presenting to C-suite audiences 

· Excellent storytelling, narrative development, and written communication skills 

· Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence in matrixed environments 

· Comfort navigating ambiguity with an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven mindset 

· Willingness to travel up to 40%

· Open to candidates in PST, MST and PST time zones, with a strong preference for PST

Role Summary

The Director, Partner Co‑Innovation & Strategic Execution is a senior individual contributor accountable for advancing Adobe’s partner co‑innovation strategy through disciplined execution, operating model leadership, and executive‑level decision support. This role operates at the intersection of strategy and execution, translating complex partner opportunities into structured, scalable co‑innovation motions that drive early adoption, pipeline creation, and long‑term ecosystem impact.

With broad autonomy and significant influence, the Director owns critical components of the partner co‑innovation operating model and leads high‑visibility partner‑led solution initiatives with GSIs and agencies. The role is expected to operate independently in ambiguous environments, exercise sound judgment, and shape outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders

Core Responsibilities

1. Strategic Ownership of the Partner Co‑Innovation Operating Model

Own and evolve core elements of Adobe’s partner co‑innovation operating model, ensuring clarity, consistency, and scalability across initiatives

Lead complex, multi‑party solution co‑creation efforts, aligning Adobe’s product and architectural capabilities with partner‑led solution strategies

Define solution success criteria, maturity models, milestones, and validation paths that support monetization and field readiness

Establish standards for solution documentation, readiness artifacts, and maturity checkpoints used across teams and leadership forums

2. Senior IC Leadership within Co‑Innovation Programs

Serve as a senior IC leader within the co‑innovation program, accountable for execution quality, momentum, and outcomes across priority initiatives

Own partner intake and progression mechanisms, including structured engagement through Joint Partnership Agreements

Ensure co‑innovation initiatives are aligned with field, industry, and revenue priorities to maximize downstream impact

Shape operating cadences, governance rhythms, and leadership‑ready narratives that enable informed decision‑making

3. Executive‑Level Execution and Governance Leadership

Lead development of executive‑level materials, insights, and recommendations for senior governance and strategic forums

Own tracking, synthesis, and interpretation of solution maturity, pipeline signals, and early impact indicators

Proactively identify risks, interdependencies, and execution gaps; drive resolution through influence and escalation as needed

Ensure partner‑led initiatives progress with predictability and discipline from incubation through early field enablement

Role Summary 

We are seeking a PMO lead to oversee a complex, multiyear, multi workstream strategic partnership involving co-innovation, solution development, services delivery, product integration, and coordinated GTM activation. 

This role serves as the central program leader responsible for ensuring operational rigor, workstream discipline, cross functional synchronization, structured governance, and predictable execution across all partnership activities. The PMO Lead ensures that all workstream sponsors follow through on their commitments, business cases, and delivery milestones while also coordinating closely with internal functions such as legal, sourcing, finance, product, engineering, partner marketing, and field teams. 

This is a high visibility role that requires exceptional program leadership, strong commercial acumen, and experience orchestrating complex crossfunctional initiatives in fast moving environments. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Governance & Operating Cadence 

Own and operate the end-to-end governance model across all participating organizations. 

Establish and run structured partnership cadences, including monthly, quarterly, and executive level reviews. 

Manage issue and risk escalation processes across workstream, program, and executive levels. 

Maintain clear and consistent communication loops between workstream owners, alliance management, executive sponsors, and technical leadership. 

Establish and maintain a structured PMO operating model aligned to multi-year strategic investments. 

2. Workstream Oversight 

Oversee execution quality and pacing across all defined workstreams, which may include areas such as presales support, value realization, consulting delivery, product integration, GTM enablement, and innovation programs. 

Ensure each workstream maintains clear deliverables, KPIs, milestones, risks, business case assumptions, and success measurements. 

Track progress across all workstreams through standardized dashboards, status reviews, and structured accountability mechanisms. 

3. SOW Development, Contracting & Compliance 

Lead the orchestration of Statements of Work (SOWs) across all workstreams. 

Coordinate with internal legal, sourcing, finance, and relevant workstream sponsors to ensure timely drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of all SOWs. 

Maintain a comprehensive view of all contractual obligations, delivery timelines, dependencies, and cross functional requirements. 

Monitor SLA compliance for approvals, and onboarding. 

4. Product & Engineering Integration Program Management 

Partner closely with product and engineering teams to ensure that roadmap integration commitments are clearly defined, resourced, and progressing as planned. 

Track endtoend delivery of technical integration milestones. 

Ensure alignment between engineering delivery, workstream interdependencies, and GTM timelines. 

5. GTM, Partner Marketing & Field Alignment 

Drive coordinated GTM execution across partner marketing, sales, and alliance leadership. 

Ensure the creation of messaging, positioning, enablement assets, solution packaging, and field ready materials. 

Support demand generation initiatives, joint marketing motions, and field activation programs. 

Partner with the partner management team to track adoption metrics, pipeline influence, and revenue aligned outcomes associated with the joint solutions. 

6. Investment Oversight/Management 

Maintain comprehensive oversight of the company’s multiyear strategic commitment with the external partner under the governing commercial agreement. 

Track all spending across workstreams, ensuring alignment to agreed upon annual and total targets set forth in the partnership framework. 

Reconcile all Eligible Fees, monitor burn rate, and validate quarterly spend reports received from the partner, including identifying discrepancies and driving resolution through the governance process. 

Ensure spend progress is accurately reflected against each workstream’s commitments, success measures, and performance expectations. 

Maintain realtime visibility into pacing, forecasts, risks, and remaining balance toward the overall spend commitment, providing structured insights to senior leadership. 

Coordinate closely with workstream sponsors, sourcing, legal, finance, and partner management teams to ensure all spending is properly attributed, contractually compliant, and aligned to strategic outcomes. 

Support governance reviews by preparing executive ready summaries of investment performance, pacing, risks, and mitigation plans. 

7. Executive Reporting & Insights 

Create executive ready reports summarizing progress across workstreams, technical integrations, GTM activities, risks, and program health. 

Provide structured insights, scenario analysis, and data driven recommendations to senior leadership. 

Maintain realtime dashboards on program performance, risks, and strategic milestones. 

Success Metrics 

Success for this role includes: 

Operational discipline and predictability across all workstreams 

Timely execution of SOWs, integration milestones, and GTM deliverables 

Institutionalized governance rhythms with consistent cross functional participation 

Highquality strategic reporting to executive and cross functional leadership 

Measurable impact on product integration progress, solution readiness, and GTM performance 

Positive stakeholder feedback across internal teams and partner organizations 

Experience & Qualifications 

Required 

10+ years of PMO leadership or enterprise program management experience 

Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multiworkstream programs 

Experience coordinating across product, engineering, sales, legal, sourcing, and marketing functions 

Strong financial, operational, and commercial acumen 

Exceptional communication skills and executive presence 

Ability to drive clarity, alignment, and accountability across matrixed teams 

Preferred 

Background in SaaS, digital experience platforms, enterprise transformations, or co-innovation programs 

Experience with ecosystem partnerships, creative/marketing technology, or AI enabled workflows 

Familiarity with large scale GTM motions and joint solution development 

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months 

Governance operating rhythm fully established and adopted 

Relevant workstream SOWs executed on time and aligned to program requirements 

Stakeholders across all functions report high satisfaction with program structure and execution 

Program is operating predictably, transparently, and with clear accountability

You understand the business, not just the calendar. You learn the executive’s priorities, stakeholder map, and active workstreams so you can make smart scheduling decisions autonomously. When an executive requests time, you know whether it’s urgent or can wait — and you act accordingly.

You own outcomes, not tasks. You don’t wait to be told a conflict exists — you surface it and propose a solution before the executive notices.

You keep pace under pressure. When priorities shift three times before lunch, you stay calm, reprioritize, and communicate changes clearly. You thrive in high-tempo environments and don’t freeze when things move fast.

You keep the executive accountable. You are comfortable telling the executive what needs to happen next, pulling them out of a meeting that’s running over, and reminding them of commitments they’ve lost track of. You see yourself as an operational partner, not a support function.

You build systems, not workarounds. Repeating processes frustrate you. You build templates, standing blocks, and protocols that prevent problems from recurring.
 

What You Will Own

Calendar Strategy & Prioritization (Primary)

Business-context-driven scheduling: Understand the executive’s priorities, active workstreams, and stakeholder landscape well enough to make informed decisions about which meetings to accept, decline, or reschedule — without requiring executive input on every request.

Proactive conflict resolution: Own the end-to-end executive calendar across Outlook. Identify and resolve conflicts before they surface — daily, not weekly. When inbound demand is high, triage based on urgency and business impact.

Stakeholder coordination: Schedule and reschedule across cross-functional leadership, external partners, and direct reports with clear communication to all affected parties.

Weekly reconciliation: Maintain a standing weekly sync with each executive to align priorities, flag upcoming conflicts, and confirm the next week’s schedule.

Meeting hygiene: Ensure every calendar invite includes agendas, prep materials, and correct attendees. Decline or defer low-priority requests on behalf of executives.
 

Executive Time Management & Pacing

Keep the executive on track: Proactively remind the executive of upcoming meetings, hard stops, and commitments throughout the day. When the executive gets pulled into unplanned conversations or runs over, you are the one who brings them back on schedule.

Protect focus time: Build and defend blocks for deep work, prep time, and flows across meetings. Push back on requests that erode these blocks without a strong business reason.

Surface what needs attention: Flag overdue action items, approaching deadlines, and commitments the executive may have lost visibility on.

Meeting Preparation & Follow-Up

Prepare briefing documents and context materials ahead of leadership reviews and external meetings.

Track recurring commitments (QBRs, planning cycles, leadership reviews) and proactively build them into the calendar.

Travel & Expenses

Coordinate domestic and international business travel end-to-end: flights, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries.

Submit and reconcile expense reports in a timely manner, flagging any policy questions proactively.

Team Events & Operations

Plan and implement team offsites, all-hands meetings, team-building activities, and cross-functional events.

Coordinate space planning, floor moves, and team logistics as needed.

Provide on-site support at Adobe events and conferences (occasional travel required).

Cross-Functional EA Coordination

Build strong relationships with EAs across Adobe to facilitate cross-org scheduling.

Provide backup coverage during PTO, illness, or sabbatical for peer EAs.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of clear, proactive communication.

Proficiency with Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, and standard enterprise productivity tools.

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking an experienced transactional legal counsel to join our Adobe Global Partner Legal team as Senior Legal Counsel. This role offers an excellent opportunity to provide outstanding legal expertise for our innovative Creativity & Productivity and Customer Experience Orchestration products. You will be an essential part of a dynamic team, working closely with highly experienced professionals to facilitate strategic partnerships and business development transactions. If you are hardworking, have a positive attitude, with a passion for legal precision and advanced solutions, and a desire to enhance flawless digital experiences, Adobe is the ideal environment for you!

What you'll Do 

Structure, draft, review, negotiate, and lead a wide variety of agreements, including strategic partnerships, custom outbound partnerships, technology licenses, and strategic vendor agreements.

Help drive and structure various Creativity & Productivity product-related agreements and programs.

Cultivate knowledge in our Creativity & Productivity and Customer Experience Orchestration solutions (including AI) to offer support through outbound partnerships (and inbound partnerships where needed).

Evaluate and successfully implement continuous improvements for standard terms, templates, and legal processes.

Keep abreast of the rapidly changing industry and legal landscape.

Build positive relationships and advise multiple levels of management on legal issues.

What you need to succeed 

J.D. from an accredited law school and membership in good standing of at least one state bar.

10+ years of relevant legal experience, particularly with complex commercial and technology agreements, and some in-house experience preferred.

Proven drafting skills and experience leading complex deal negotiations.

Highly effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to frame complex legal issues succinctly and communicate with all levels of the organization.

Dedication to providing clients with high-quality and timely legal and business advice.

Proven creative problem-solving capabilities, good business instincts and the ability to apply common sense to provide both practical and theoretical advice.

Excellent cross-functional skills and ability to work well with internal colleagues (including those in different time zones).

Collaborative, can-do attitude, genuine, owns the outcome, and a desire to be the best colleague you can be to make an impact on and build an exciting career at Adobe.

The Opportunity 

Join the group of attorneys and paralegals who provide legal counsel to the product teams at Adobe who develop and market Adobe Acrobat. We are seeking a hardworking, positive and high-energy lawyer to support product and business teams for Adobe Acrobat. You will work closely with product management, engineering, business strategy and marketing teams, as well as colleagues in Legal, to provide counseling on a range of legal topics including innovative generative Ai technologies. You will be based in San Jose or San Francisco, CA, or Seattle, WA, will report to the lead of the Acrobat legal team, and will help advance our clients' business objectives while managing legal and brand/reputational risk.

What you'll Do 

Assist the team with innovative GenerativeAI functions, evaluating products from a GenAI lens, considering associated risks, reviewing synthetic and other data sets, and generally being mentored by senior lawyers who do this daily.

Support and build positive relationships with our product development teams.

Collaborate with our clients in reviewing products, business strategies and initiatives to assess legal compliance and provide practical advice.

Coordinate with subject matter leads in Adobe’s Legal Department, including privacy, antitrust and intellectual property attorneys.

Develop and deliver materials and trainings to various internal groups, including engineering, program management and sales-legal.

Draft and negotiate all types of technology licensing agreements: both in-bound and out-bound licenses and partnership agreements.

What you need to succeed 

J.D. from an accredited law school and necessary bar membership

1-2 years of relevant legal experience, with software and online services industry experience.

Proficient at negotiating and drafting various intellectual property agreements including in-and out-bound technology licenses, development agreements, online services agreements, and terms of use for online services.

Familiarity with privacy and data security issues and compliance (experience with privacy by design is strongly preferred).

Prior experience with user-generated content services and mobile app development strongly preferred.

Technical background or a geek-level interest in software products and development preferred.

A flexible, business-friendly collaborator who thinks creatively and enjoys working with technical issues.

Candidate must possess a sense of humor and enjoy working on a team and with people at all levels.

Smart, creative, hard worker with boundless intellectual curiosity.

Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

A commitment to providing clients with high quality, timely legal advice, eager to tackle different types of products and services and related adventures.

Flexibility to work with colleagues, clients and others in time zones other than where the position is based.

Ability to exercise common sense to provide both practical and theoretical advice; must be a creative problem-solver and have good business instincts.

Desire to make an impact and build an exciting career with our team.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Director to lead our global Business Ethics and Integrity group. This is an exciting opportunity to join Adobe’s Legal and Government Relations organization and help shape a world-class ethics and compliance program. Reporting to Adobe’s Vice President and Chief Compliance Officer, you’ll be working on the front lines to ensure that Adobe acts with integrity in all areas of its business.

You’ll bring deep expertise in building and scaling ethics, compliance and risk management programs and governance. You’re a strong people leader who thrives on inspiring teams, mentoring and developing talent. You love working cross-functionally to build and maintain collaborative working relationships throughout the company. You’ll work closely with senior leadership and business partners to maintain Adobe’s culture of integrity, operate compliance programs at scale, and manage and mitigate risk to the company.

What You’ll Do

Lead and continuously evolve a global program aligned to regulatory expectations, company strategy and enterprise risk priorities.

Manage global anti-corruption and third-party compliance programs including program design, operations, advice, M&A due diligence and integrations, and risk-based monitoring.

Collaborate with legal and business colleagues to ensure compliance with public sector laws and regulations.

Develop and implement scalable training and awareness efforts aligned to Adobe's core values, business risk, and legal/regulatory requirements. Establish metrics and analytics to identify program effectiveness, gaps and emerging risk trends.

Build and mature compliance risk assessment processes, strengthen controls and monitoring systems in partnership with cross-functional teams.

Drive continuous innovation, scale and efficiency by using AI and other technologies in all aspects of program design and execution, including risk assessment, governance, training and educating, monitoring and testing, and reporting.

Lead and develop a distributed, high-impact team with a focus on scaling efficiently for present and future needs.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field; advanced degree such as J.D. or MBA and/or professional certification (e.g., CCPE) is preferred.

12+ years of relevant experience, with Fortune 250 experience preferred; 5+ years of people management experience.

A strong moral compass coupled with exceptional judgment and the ability to effectively balance priorities and manage risk in a highly dynamic, global environment.

Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, strong executive presence and experience building relationships, leading teams, and influencing across all levels of the company.

A global mentality, an unflaggingly positive attitude, and a great sense of humor.

The Sales Transformation Portfolio Manager plays a critical role in orchestrating how sales transformation initiatives are evaluated, prioritized, governed, and communicated across the organization. This role ensures initiative intake is structured, data is accurate, progress is visible, and leadership has the insights needed to make informed decisions. The Portfolio Manager helps establish the operating rhythm, frameworks, and standards that enable the Sales Transformation Office to run effectively and scale as the portfolio grows.

This individual acts as the connective tissue across strategic programs, business leaders, and cross functional partners. They own the portfolio operating model, ensure data-driven decision-making, and provide transparency into initiative performance, value delivery, and risk areas. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong analytical, operational, and organizational experience with the ability to create clarity, structure, and insight in fast-moving environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Intake, Prioritization, and Planning

Manage the intake process for new sales transformation initiatives, ensuring clear scope, business case, and alignment to strategic objectives.

Develop and manage prioritization frameworks to determine sequencing, dependencies, and resource considerations across the portfolio.

Maintain an accurate, up-to-date source of truth portfolio view, capturing progress, risks, interdependencies, and value delivery.

Partner with leaders across sales, marketing, finance, operations, and product to ensure initiatives are properly defined and positioned for success.

Data Management and Insights

Own initiative data quality across systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

Create standard data structures, definitions, and reporting guidelines for use across the Transformation Office.

Define and maintain portfolio-level KPIs, value realization measures, and reporting logic.

Executive Dashboarding and Visibility

Develop and maintain executive dashboards that provide a clear view into progress, risks, trends, value delivery, and overall portfolio health.

Translate complex program data into meaningful insights for executive audiences.

Provide timely reporting to leadership, enabling informed decisions and proactive interventions.

Governance and Operating Rhythm

Establish and manage the governance framework used to monitor progress, escalate risks, and ensure accountability across initiatives.

Lead cross portfolio forums, including leadership reviews, operating cadences, and decision-making sessions.

Maintain consistent operating rhythms, guiding the organization through structured, predictable, and transparent review cycles.

Frameworks, Standards, and Tooling

Own the Transformation Office’s portfolio and program delivery standards, frameworks, templates, and methodologies.

Define and enforce consistent practices across initiative planning, reporting, and status management.

Evaluate, implement, and manage tooling to support portfolio management, reporting, and collaboration.

Partner with program leaders to ensure adoption and consistent application of standards and tools.

Cross Functional Partnership and Enablement

Partner closely with program managers and business leaders to maintain high-quality plans, data, and reporting.

Support initiative teams in following the Transformation Office framework and best practices.

Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and operational excellence across the transformation ecosystem.

Qualifications:

Required

8–12+ years of experience in portfolio management, PMO operations, transformation support, or strategic program management.

Proven experience managing cross-functional portfolios and creating prioritization or governance models.

Strong analytical skills with experience designing dashboards and communicating insights to executive audiences.

Ability to design and operationalize frameworks, standards, and scalable processes.

Demonstrated success bringing structure, clarity, and organization to complex, ambiguous environments.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex information.

Preferred

Experience within a Transformation Office, Enterprise PMO, or Strategy/Operations team.

Background supporting sales, go-to-market, or revenue-driving initiatives.

Familiarity with portfolio management or BI tools such as Smartsheet, Workfront, Tableau, or Power BI.

Experience in SaaS, technology, or consulting environments.

Key Competencies

Portfolio management and prioritization

Governance and operating model design

Data quality, metrics, and dashboarding

Executive reporting and storytelling

Cross-functional coordination

Process design and standardization

Analytical problem solving

Organizational clarity and structure

Why This Role Matters

This role is foundational to the effectiveness of the Sales Transformation Office. By owning intake, prioritization, governance, and portfolio visibility, the Portfolio Lead/Manager ensures the organization invests in the right initiatives and delivers measurable outcomes. This role provides the insights, structure, and operational discipline that empower leadership to make high-quality decisions and accelerate transformation across the business.

The Opportunity

The Americas is Adobe’s largest region, and you will join at a key moment to design, develop, and help deliver our future. You will work closely with senior sales leaders in the region to improve our business. As the head of Revenue Retention & Growth Strategy for the Americas region, you will focus on driving strong recurring revenue growth and managing change across Enterprise Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partners.

We seek someone with a customer experience focus who is both highly effective and efficient. They must think strategically and be ready to tackle hands-on work.

We’ll need you to develop and drive the renewals strategy and maintain a regular schedule of business reviews. You will also manage day-to-day operations within the Americas while working with a global cross-functional team for support.

What you’ll do

Work in close partnership with sales and customer success executive leadership to direct the operations of the renewals business

Manage field sales and ecosystem annual planning, encompassing the determination of financial objectives, organizational setup, account distribution, capacity modeling, territory allocation, quota setting, and compensation frameworks for the renewals business.

Lead, coordinate and refine the renewal forecasting cadence, processes and artifacts, driving predictability.

Develop and implement productivity and performance reporting for renewals management, individuals, and account opportunity.

Support and optimize the renewals strategy including core sales processes and efficiency drivers, infrastructure and automation, regional performance and Enterprise Data Driven Operating model.

Establish highly repeatable (and scalable) sales processes, automation and reporting methodology, both quantitative and qualitative that can be implemented across regions, and provide deep insights.

Lead key sales productivity initiatives across Americas; focused on customer success, retention, bookings growth and ecosystem alignment

Maintain strong relationships with Americas peers and collaborators to evaluate effectiveness of programs and impact of operational strategies, programs and improvements

Effectively partner and appropriately challenge leadership to effectively overachieve targets and instill centralized processes.

Accountability to assist renewals teams to improve performance through the development and driving deep adoption of both strategic and tactical programs.

Job Description

Principal TAM – P50

Join a dedicated team at Adobe and contribute to the technical success of our largest customers. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to craft the future of Adobe's customer engagement strategy and make a significant impact. You will work with a diverse range of collaborators, applying your expertise to successfully implement innovative solutions and ensuring magnificent execution of customer strategies. This is your chance to be part of a ground-breaking organization that values teamwork, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

Lead Ultimate Support engagement(s) for leading Indian BFSI customers, serving as the technical executive point of contact throughout the Customer's solution usage lifecycle.

Highly focused on advising & consulting and support customer's technical strategy with Adobe Solutions via service delivery plans with clear outcomes.

Assess strategic Customer technical risks and opportunities, driving the extended Adobe team to build and deliver mitigation and "get well" plans with leadership teams.

Drive clear communication across Customer operational areas. Maintain regular and appropriate governance with both internal and external executive teams.

Advocate for Customer across internal Adobe teams. Optimize the client's investment and accelerate task, issue execution, and resolution.

Drive innovation, roadmap influence, standard methodologies, and process improvement back into the Adobe ecosystem.

Responsible for the global engagement model and review cycle across multiple business units and/or brands.

Consolidate collaboration and cadence across all technical partners and influence delivery achievements across multi-solution, multi-discipline engagements.

Work hands-on with Adobe's internal collaborators like Customer Success Management, Managed Services, Engineering, TechOps, Product Management, Support, and the Adobe Consulting practice and third-party partners in support of customer's success.

Lead a matrixed services team that may involve multiple project teams from Adobe or client or partner organizations. Develop efficient & effective working relationships with Customer partners.

Make recommendations on how new and existing features fit within customers' environments, supplying standard methodologies and recommendations.

Lead project-based, consultant-led architectural and design discussions to ensure solutions are optimized and ready for maximum value delivery.

Mentor immediate team members as needed & develop skills within the team.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor's Degree in a related technical industry subject area or equivalent experience. An MBA is preferred.

15+ years of experience in a senior capacity in consultative, customer service, customer success, and/or related roles in digital marketing technology.

Strong executive presence with ability to collaborate across multiple teams throughout Adobe and client-side VPs, including CMOs and CXOs.

Excellent presentation skills, confident phone and conference presence, and the ability to lead meetings, workshops, and reviews in front of any audience size.

Strong conflict-resolution skills to drive closure to customer concerns and open technical issues.

Outstanding customer-facing skills that enable you to represent Adobe best within a customer's environment.

Validated interpersonal, prioritization skills, and an ability to work in a highly matrixed environment.

Capable of driving timely resolution across a broad set of issues with the Customer: technical, architecture, business process, and partnerships.

Ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges to help our customers realize their software investments, efficiencies, advantages, and innovations.

Awareness of development methodologies and technologies, and understanding of and experience with marketing software and domain principles.

Experience with Adobe ecosystem. Business practitioner level knowledge with more than one of the Adobe Experience Cloud products. Adobe DX Certifications are highly desirable.

Validated experience working with BFSI clients, with a deep understanding of key challenges such as compliance, personalization, omnichannel engagement, and the implications of industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, PCI DSS) on data management.

Ability to travel to the Mumbai client location (approximately 50-75 percent) as required.

The Challenge 

We are looking for a highly motivated individuals knowledgeable in ML Ops/ Platform engineering to be part of our Advertising Cloud Search, Social, Commerce, a leading digital marketing spend optimization platform helping enterprise clients achieving their marketing goals. We are now faced with exciting challenge of continuing the legacy and at the same time evolving and owning the digital marketing space through our innovative solutions. It's a robust agile team that collaborates and works across all functions of true product development. You must be that individual who is highly engaged, motivated and excels at critical thinking and problem solving!

What you’ll do

Model Lifecycle Management: Manage model versioning, deployment strategies, rollback mechanisms, and A/B testing frameworks. Coordinate model registries, artifacts, and promotion workflows in collaboration with ML Engineers Develop CI/CD and orchestration workflows using GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Airflow, Argo Workflows, or similar tools.

Review and optimize data science models, including code refactoring, containerization, deployment, versioning, and performance tuning. Implement model testing, validation, and automated QA pipelines, ensuring reproducibility and compliance. 

Monitor models in production, including data drift, concept drift, performance degradation, and system reliability. 

Collaborate multi-functionally with data scientists, data engineers, and architects; build documentation and improve team processes. 

Ensure governance, security, and compliance for ML pipelines (access controls, audit logs, model reproducibility, lineage). 

What you need to succeed

Bachelor's degree or advanced degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field. 

Strong ability to design and implement cloud architectures for end-to-end ML workflows on AWS.

Hands-on experience with MLOps frameworks like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow or similar. 

Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), and enterprise platforms like OpenShift. 

Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with Go, Ruby, or Bash scripting. Experience with common ML libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch. 

Experience with software engineering guidelines including version control, testing, and automation. 

Ability to understand data science workflows, experiment tracking, and feature engineering tools. 

Strong communication skills; ability to work collaboratively in multi-functional teams.

Knowledge of cloud services such as AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI. 

Exposure to feature stores like Feast, Tecton, or Databricks Feature Store. 

Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, Datadog). 

Experience implementing model governance & lineage with tools like MLflow Registry, SageMaker Model Registry, or Vertex ML Metadata. 

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

The Opportunity

Step into the position of Adobe Experience Platform Data Solutions Engineer in San Jose, CA. Join a dynamic team enthusiastic about innovation and committed to building new solutions on powerful technology! Collaborate with engaged colleagues in an inclusive work environment. Your impact will extend to millions worldwide and help Adobe fulfill its vision of empowering creativity and transforming digital environments.

In this role, you will collaborate within the Adobe Experience Platform suite, leveraging scalable data infrastructure, machine learning models, and a personalization platform. You will independently address data onboarding requests and aid teams in onboarding data to activate campaigns and personalized experiences! The ideal candidate enjoys working together with data science and product SDK teams to develop resilient solutions.

ATTENTION: This position requires hands-on expertise with Adobe Experience Platform, including direct involvement in data workflows, identity, and governance procedures within the platform. Candidates with substantial, practical AEP experience will be strongly preferred.

What you will do

Build, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes to support data-driven decision-making.

Collaborate with multi-functional teams including business partners and engineers to determine data requirements and successfully implement data solutions.

Have an Enterprise outlook when facing challenging business and data problems. This ensures the solution meets the needs of the entire Enterprise, not just one business unit.

Possess the knowledge and experience to advocate for the “right” data solution vs. compromises that will not withstand Enterprise rigor.

Ensure data accuracy and code integrity through strict quality control measures.

Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for data processes and solutions.

Represent internal business teams feedback on platform capabilities that will inform the broader product and engineering roadmap for internal Adobe tools.
 

What you will need

Minimum of 1-3 years of hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform offerings such as Real Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Demonstrated expertise in schema building, data pipeline configuration, profile management, and ETL procedures.

Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, API, and data visualization tools.

Outstanding problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Ability to work collaboratively in an ambitious, fast-paced environment.

Technical certification in AEP RTCDP strongly preferred.

Job Description

Position Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity to join the India Shared Services Finance team as we continue to shift to drive the business through data-driven forecasts and providing influential insights. This Senior Financial Analyst position will support Mfg. COGs, Localization Mktg and headcount and expense planning. In this role, you will be responsible for a wide range of projects in support of key business decisions and fiscal deliverable. You will develop and maintain frameworks for quarterly & annual budgets, drive consolidation of in-quarter outlook forecast, analyze and report on financial data,

Responsibilities include:

Preparing annual/quarterly budgets and weekly/monthly forecasts for Mfg. COGs, ensuring a high level of accuracy, analyzing units / cost of sales trend, E&O inventory analysis, accruals/allocations of direct costs (Mfg.COGs), GL recon, monthly/quarterly reporting.

Prepare reporting for annual/quarterly budgets and weekly/monthly forecasts, ensuring a high level of headcount and expense predictability for the identified organization, review for completeness and summarize key variances

Prepare trended analytics for key areas such as headcount attrition, employee costs, and travel spend

Generate outlook and controller’s letter reporting

Leverage Power BI/Tableau to create and maintain centralized and common reporting and analytical solutions 

Drive continual process improvements, framework enhancements in support of generating meaningful data-driven insights

Collaborate with finance controllers/consolidators to drive fiscal deliverable, gain comprehension of variance drivers, and challenge assumptions/methodologies employed

Ad-hoc analysis as required, and self-initiated projects encouraged

Requirements:

Positive attitude and comfort in an environment subject to change as the business evolves

Bachelor's degree in business, finance or related field; CA/MBA preferred.

10+ years of FP&A (or related) experience required, preferably with a US-based company

Strong analytical and accounting skills; must understand key business drivers, ability to communicate financial implications/business impact and provide recommendations with attention to detail

Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

Ability to take charge, set objectives, drive to results

Exceptional follow-through capabilities

Willingness and ability to quickly master new tools and processes

Advanced Excel skills are essential, and experience in Tableau and Anaplan are preferred. SAP and PowerPoint are also useful.

The Opportunity 

The Corporate Shared Services Business Capability Design & Delivery (BCDD) team provides strategic partnership and engagement that delivers end-to-end capabilities for Adobe’s Finance, Legal and Security platforms & applications.

We are looking for a technical leader with executive presence, outstanding interpersonal skills, and the ability to influence at all levels to drive multi-functional initiatives and deliver Adobe’s strategic roadmap.

Possess a well-rounded technical background and have demonstrated expertise leading complex programs in matrix organizations to deliver solutions that delight the customers.

Role and Responsibilities

Build a project timeline and partner with BCDD Leadership, Product Management, Engineering and Business Stakeholders to understand the Vision, Mission, and Strategic Objectives for the Business Units and ATS (Adobe Technology Services).

Engage with ATS and Business teams who support the initiatives to estimate the level of effort and feasibility of delivery.

Manage product lines built on SAP

Discuss trade-offs, sequencing, incremental funding as needed, BU staffing, etc. Assist Product Managers and Engineers with project reporting

Plan and facilitate Discovery/Proof of Concept/Pre-project work and set up Program Governance, inc. meeting cadence and key artifacts (Scrum of Scrums/Operating Committee/Steering Committee, Wiki, SharePoint, Project Schedule, RAID log, etc.).

Work multi-functionally to understand dependencies and constraints. Determine resource requirements and build the case, program roadmap, including landmarks and deliveries, and secure approvals.

Execution & Monitoring: Coordinate the program execution and proactively manage changes and risks. Work with program teams and partners to ensure timely decisions, clear and accurate communication, and plan adjustments.

Coordinate Release announcement, Hypercare, Decommissioning, etc. as needed and disband the team.

Measure adoption and impact post-release, inc. 30/60/90 days check-ins and feedback loop (to inform future decisions/commitments).

What is needed to succeed 

Bachelors or equivalent a must; MBA or equivalent preferred

Certification a plus: PMP, PMI-ACP, PgMP, CSM

7+ years' experience as a Program Manager in software and/or related technology industry, preferably in a technology landscape role with exposure to Finance teams.

Experience using SAP S/4Hana preferred

Experience managing multi-discipline teams consisting of business and technical resources.

Experience using various project delivery methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall and hybrid) and tailoring the approach for program success.

Self-motivated and a positive attitude that helps you to adapt to change.

Resourcefulness and a creative approach to problem-solving to succeed in a collaborative culture.

Operate effectively and autonomously in time-sensitive situations ambiguous environment and recognizing critical issue.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to engage with technical and non-technical audiences.

The opportunity 

The Adobe Design Content Strategy (ADCS) team is looking for a Staff UX Content Strategist to join our team, supporting Frame.io. We use our expertise in language and communication to shape experiences across Adobe’s products and services. Our work ranges from content design and in-product, UX writing to developing standards and guidelines for our design system, and more. 

Frame.io, an Adobe Company, is changing the future of how creative work gets done by helping over 1 million creative professionals seamlessly collaborate from all over the world. We have built a product that creatives recognize and love through constant innovation and incredible attention to detail.

Important note: This is not a content marketing or advertising copywriting role.

What you’ll do 

As part of the ADCS team, you’ll be the lead UX content strategist for Frame.io, where you’ll:

Define and drive the content strategy vision for Frame.io’s product experience, from onboarding to advanced workflows.

Partner with product, engineering, research, and design leads to create cohesive, user-centered experiences.

Craft clear, purposeful, and on-brand in-product content that supports Frame.io.

Lead UX content strategy for major product initiatives, owning end-to-end content execution across surfaces and platforms.

Develop and scale content frameworks, voice and tone guidelines, and reusable patterns specific to Frame.io, ensuring they align with and complement Adobe’s broader design and content system, Spectrum. 

Identify and lead high-impact opportunities to evolve product language, taxonomy, and information architecture.

Mentor designers and cross-functional teammates on best practices in UX writing, content design, and systems thinking.

Collaborate with the broader Adobe Design org to ensure consistency across Adobe Creative Cloud experiences.

Use research and data to validate content decisions and advocate for user needs and clarity. 

Establish and lead content workflows and processes across the Frame.io design and product teams, ensuring a consistent, content-first approach that delivers high-quality, reliable outcomes.

What you need to succeed

7+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or UX content strategy within a product design environment.

Mastery of content strategy and design practices, including expertise in naming and messaging. 

A strong portfolio of work that showcases strategic thinking skills, high attention to craft, and a clear design point of view in your work. 

Strong storytelling skills to communicate complex visions and influence stakeholders.

Ability to develop and test a range of content and design solutions across different styles and contexts.

A collaborative mindset and ability to work peer-to-peer with senior leaders across functions.

Passion for user advocacy and a commitment to elevating design quality and consistency. 

Experience developing taxonomies and information architectures that support intuitive navigation, content discovery, and scalable design systems.

Experience with Figma and other collaborative design tools. 

Nice to have, but not required

Experience working with digital/media asset management systems

Systems and standards development

Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud apps

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join the GenStudio Engineering team. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building scalable, high-impact software solutions. You will drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and influence the technical direction of GenStudio.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, test, and maintain AI/ML-based systems and applications that serve as the backbone of scalable, production-ready technology stacks.

Frame product features as ML tasks (e.g., classification, recommendation, context engineering).

Analyze trade-offs across cost, latency, and accuracy while ensuring compliance with UX, privacy, legal, and security constraints.

Assess data distribution (variance, sampling, drift) and manage data labeling workflows involving LLMs, SMEs, or user-generated activity.

Organize datasets for training, validation, and testing, and engineer high-quality features using normalization, smoothing, and weighting techniques.

Implement and adapt techniques from academic research and industry papers; evaluate algorithmic trade-offs considering data requirements, latency, and runtime.

Handle cold-start scenarios and mitigate overfitting/underfitting challenges.

Define offline benchmarks and metrics; design and analyze A/B tests to validate online performance.

Architect scalable ML systems (e.g., multi-agent, recommender, active learning, multi-stage model training, enterprise search) for both offline and online workflows.

Optimize model development and deployment in GPU/TPU environments using PyTorch.

Work cross-functionally with data, research, and product teams to translate models into production-ready services.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

12+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of technical leadership.

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Proven expertise in Machine Learning and Deep Learning, including model design, optimization, and fine-tuning.

Strong understanding of transfer learning principles and their application in production settings.

Proficiency in Python (especially for data workflows) and experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, CUDA, Hugging Face, and JAX.

Experience designing and deploying scalable AI/ML systems optimized for GPU/TPU environments.

Solid grasp of data engineering concepts—including dataset management, feature engineering, and handling data drift.

Ability to balance theoretical ML knowledge with practical, high-performance implementation.

Strong understanding of how to transform models into reliable, production-grade services.

Preferred Attributes

Recognized as a thought leader within and beyond the organization.

Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and evangelize new technologies.

Experience with building GenAI-first applications.

Contributions to industry forums, conferences, or open-source communities.

The opportunity

Frame.io, an Adobe Company, is changing the future of how creative work gets done by helping over 1 million creative professionals seamlessly collaborate from all over the world. We have built a product creatives recognize and love through constant innovation and incredible attention to detail.

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of creative collaboration at a pivotal moment. Creative workflows and tools are rapidly evolving with the advent of generative AI and new technologies like Frame.io’s Camera to Cloud. You'll be at the forefront of this transformation—defining unique experiences and pioneering new patterns that shape how millions of creatives work. You'll tackle some of our most complex and ambiguous product challenges, set the bar for craft excellence, and work as a strategic thought partner to product and engineering leadership in this exciting, fast-paced space.

This is a role for an accomplished designer who combines strategic product thinking with exceptional craft. You'll be equally comfortable defining long-term product vision, diving deep into interaction details, and mentoring other designers to elevate their work. You should possess mastery-level design skills, a track record of shipping high-impact products, and an unwavering commitment to elegance and quality. Your work will inspire the team and delight millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do

Own end-to-end design for strategic, high-impact initiatives. You'll navigate ambiguity, define design strategy through rapid prototyping and validation, and execute with exceptional craft—from early concepts through implementation and post-launch iteration.

Set the standard for design excellence. Champion exceptional craft across visual design, interaction design, and product thinking. Your work will serve as a benchmark for the team and ensure every experience reflects Frame.io's commitment to fluidity, elegance, and detail.

Prototype, prototype, prototype. Our team leans heavily on prototyping to explore, communicate, iterate and validate. You’ll use the latest tools like Cursor, Figma, and more to create compelling prototypes that validate designs through experiences that can be felt and used.

Partner with product and engineering to shape product direction and build strong cross-functional relationships. Identify opportunities, define compelling visions, facilitate alignment on complex problems, and influence decisions through exceptional design work.

Stay ahead of creative technology trends. Immerse yourself in emerging tools, generative AI, and new creative workflows. Identify opportunities for Frame.io and incorporate cutting-edge patterns to keep us at the forefront of our category.

Mentor designers across the organization. Provide thoughtful feedback in design critiques, model best practices through your work, and help others grow their craft and product thinking.

What you need to succeed

8+ years of product design experience with a proven track record shipping high-quality digital products at companies known for design excellence.

Exceptional craft in visual design, interaction design, and prototyping. You create high-fidelity prototypes with the latest tools and have impeccable aesthetic judgment with obsessive attention to detail. Your work sets the bar and inspires others to push further.

Strategic product thinking with strong systems design skills. You navigate ambiguity, can understand complex workflows, and design for holistic experiences beyond individual features. You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints while ensuring your work is grounded in real customer insights.

Outstanding communication and storytelling. You articulate design thinking clearly, build compelling narratives, and influence stakeholders at all levels with confidence.

Proven ability to build strong partnerships with product managers, engineers, researchers, and designers. You create alignment through collaboration and have working knowledge of technical constraints.

Experience mentoring designers and elevating others' craft. You provide thoughtful feedback, model best practices, and lead through example and influence.

Genuine curiosity about emerging creative tools and technologies. You stay current with innovations in generative AI and creative production tools, and understand how technology is reshaping creative work.

A portfolio that itself demonstrates exceptional craft and attention to detail. Both the work shown and how you present it should showcase mastery—we look for elegant problem-solving, high-quality execution, and portfolios that reflect the same level of care and polish you bring to product work.

Why Frame.io

Join a team that's redefining how creative work happens. At Frame.io, you'll have the opportunity to impact millions of creative professionals, work alongside exceptional design talent, and craft products that people genuinely love. As part of Adobe, you'll have the resources and reach of a global leader combined with the entrepreneurial spirit and design-first culture that makes Frame.io special.

If you're an experienced designer who combines strategic thinking with exceptional craft, who thrives on solving complex problems and creating elegant solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Integrate C&P and CXO Enterprise sales approaches into a unified One Adobe framework

Build standardized pipeline health frameworks across Geos and Regions

Establish efficiency benchmarks by segment, product, and role

Lead executive-level business reviews and planning cadences

Advance Sales Productivity & Structural Efficiency

Identify structural inefficiencies in role build and seller mix

Drive structural recommendations to improve efficiency and return on investment

Partner with GTM Strategy & Ops on enterprise-wide deep dives

Operational Governance & Sales Excellence

Establish global governance for: Territory & quota changes, Headcount planning, Capacity modeling

Standardize opportunity management and account planning frameworks

Improve sales systems accuracy and planning infrastructure

Lead operational change management initiatives

Global experience as a Senior Sales Operations leader

A high-performance people leader, experience leading and developing a hard-working team with a track record of engaging and growing diverse talent to greater success

Job Summary

The Device Experience Platform Engineer is responsible for the administration, development, and continuous optimization of the Nexthink platform to improve enterprise Digital Employee Experience (DEX). Nexthink Platform Administration & Governance:

• Establish standards and protocols.

Digital Experience Analytics & Insights:
• Analyze telemetry, DEX scores, and sentiment data.
• Build dashboards and reports.
• Track key performance indicators and trends.

Nexthink Development & Automation:
• Develop Remote Actions using PowerShell.
• Build workflows using Nexthink Flow.
• Create NQL queries.

Integration & Engineering Enablement:

• Partner with endpoint and operations teams.

Continuous Improvement:

• Hands-on Nexthink administration and engineering experience.
• Expertise in Remote Actions, Flow, NQL, dashboards.

Preferred Qualifications

• Enterprise DEX experience.
• ITSM integration familiarity.
• Excellent communication skills.

• Improved DEX scores.
• Reduced incidents through automation.

• Scalable, well-governed platform.

Strategic approach with the ability to translate vision into execution

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

The opportunity 

As Business Development Representatives (BDR) for ANZ, you are responsible for helping individuals, teams, and enterprises unleash creativity and productivity with industry-leading tools like Creative Cloud, Acrobat, and Adobe Express. 

 

What you’ll do 

You are the main driving force for identifying and providing high-value opportunities into the Sales pipeline. You are the first line of relationship development with prospective high-value accounts. 
 

Build awareness and interest in Adobe’s Digital Media solutions (Creative Cloud, Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Sign, Firefly Services, etc.). 

Deliver a “consultative” approach to selling; taking time to understand the prospect’s business, their goals, objectives, and challenges before recommending a solution. 

Consistently achieve quality pipeline, progression of them & other metrics such as Inbound lead follow-up & outbound account engagement metrics. 

Manage territory creation plan for your key account executives & their accounts. Researching key accounts, identifying decision-makers, generating interest, and developing accounts to stimulate opportunity. 

Prospect, educate, qualify, and develop Target Accounts and inbound leads to create sales-ready leads and opportunities. 

Quickly route prospects and current customers to appropriate colleagues to assist in solving problems and driving value. Nurtures & provides education on areas of interest for underinformed customers. 

Setup, attend & run qualification meetings with customers in partnership with relevant Account Executive & Solution Consultants. Updating CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure capture of key history & ensuring a smooth hand-off to the relevant Account Executive as necessary. 

Exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified pipeline opportunities. 

Providing closed-loop feedback to ensure continuous process optimisation. 

The business development rep must be technical and understand Adobe's Digital Marketing solutions. 

Skills 

2 years of experience as a BDR or in a similar role, specifically supporting the creative industry space. 

Track record of successful business development in software or a tech sales environment. Knowledge of creatives within an agency environment would be an advantage. 

Self-starter with high motivation, independence, resilience, and ability to collaborate with sales & marketing teams to deliver pipe creation goals. 

Proven sales skills delivering inbound & outbound experiences and building strong relationships at multiple levels within an organisation. 

Strong communication including listening, written, and verbal skills 

Experience managing all areas of the BDR process, including account planning, pre-call preparation, opportunity qualification, and objection handling. 

Ability to quickly learn & understand sophisticated business problems & translate customers' needs into solutions plays. 

Consistently achieving inside sales goals in an automated sales environment where accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system was required. 

Positive & upbeat personality who loves to spend time engaging customers through phone, social media & email. Curious to learn; always be asking questions! 

Proficient with standard corporate productivity tools (email, voicemail, MS Office) and experience with sales tools such as Microsoft Dynamics, SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Lusha, etc. 

Strong time management and ability to ruthlessly prioritise key tasks
