Job Description

The Opportunity
The Technical Consultant designs and delivers end-to-end digital experience and commerce solutions using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Adobe Commerce. Acting as a technology advisor, this role guides clients in architectural decisions, platform integrations, and implementation strategies for measurable business impact. The architect leads solution design throughout discovery, development, deployment, and optimization phases, collaborating with business consultants, project managers, and engineering teams to ensure alignment with client objectives and Adobe best practices.

Focusing on content and commerce, the Technical Consultant unifies content management and commerce across channels, defines integration patterns, and leads technical frameworks to deliver seamless omnichannel experiences. The role also supports sales teams with solution estimation and prioritisation, requiring deep technical expertise, leadership, and cross-team collaboration.

Responsibilites:

Develop and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications using modern front-end technologies on Adobe Experience Manager.

Build reusable UI components and implement designs from wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.

Integrate front-end components with backend APIs.

Collaborate with UX/UI designers, backend developers, and content authors to deliver seamless digital experiences.

Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness across devices.

Optimize web applications for performance, scalability, and SEO best practices.

Implement accessibility standards (WCAG) and follow modern web development best practices.

Support content teams by enabling efficient content authoring within CMS/WCM platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve UI/UX issues and performance bottlenecks.

Participate in code reviews and maintain high code quality standards.

Efficiently multi-task, working across multiple client engagements at the same time as well as key internal initiatives.

Deliver high quality consulting services to our growing client base and lead ambassadorship in our client relationships.

Effectively analyze complex project issues, identify the possible solution options, and facilitate the presentation and review of the options and our recommended solution with the client.

Requirements:

2-5 years’ experience in the Web and/or ECMS technologies

2+ years of direct client consulting experience

Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as customer relationship building skills.

Articulate technical solutions and how they can solve client business problems to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Conceptually understand business requirements and translate them into architecture, design and development activities for our most complex and large Web based solutions.

Strong experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.

Proficiency with modern frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue.js, node.js or others.

Familiarity working with Web Content Management (WCM) platforms such as:

Adobe Experience Manager/Edge Delivery Services

Sitecore

Drupal

WordPress

Experience integrating CMS content with front-end components and APIs.

Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.

Familiarity with front-end frameworks that support design systems (Storybook, Bootstrap, Material UI) 

Expertise in Atomic design methodology 

Expertise in Design systems, Style guides, Pattern libraries 

Strong understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and web performance optimization.

Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and headless CMS architectures.

Experience with Git-based version control systems.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Experience with SEO best practices and analytics integration.

Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG).

Administration and debugging of Web servers, e.g. Apache.

Optimizing web solutions and architecting to accommodate performance requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent number years of experience

Position may require up to 30% travel

Role overview 

You will lead an enterprise sales organisation responsible for achieving individual sales targets through the sales of Adobe Digital Media products across Creative Cloud and Document Cloud to enterprise customers. Leading a sales team, you will work seamlessly in a matrixed environment to ensure alignment on overall go to market goals and objectives, from country to corporate level. As part of One Adobe, you will also be partnering with the Digital Experience sales leadership in driving strategic deals across the two product portfolios. You will have a consistent record of growing existing businesses and bring to bear key executive customer relationships to identify and unlock new market opportunities and in addition, have a strong, trusted network across Japan. 

 

You will be critical leader on the Japan Enterprise sales leadership team and work closely with cross-functional leaders of Sales, Marketing, Pre-sales who are collectively responsible to drive growth in our Enterprise segment. 

 

You will serve as the voice of customer and as liaison with relevant teams in region and globally to influence decisions that drive the success of your business. 

 

What you'll do 

 

• Develop and implement enterprise-level strategy to deliver sales plans to meet revenue targets 

• Align with the executive leadership team, and key partners, to define differentiated offerings and go-to-market strategies 

• Lead a balanced and predictable revenue strategy that consistently delivers on, or ahead of, plan 

• Identify, grow and accelerate revenue opportunities within key accounts 

• Optimise day-to-day sales activities and drive engagement and improve revenue conversion 

• Question the status quo and drive operational excellence 

• Provide input and develop global teams around regional input, customer sentiment, guidelines and methodology to compose strategy 

• Develop strong cross-functional relationships at senior leadership levels to align business strategy with customer needs 

• Bring togher cross functional teams to enhance commercial opportunities and identify areas of improvement 

• Work in a matrix towards to drive shared goals that are in the best interest of customers and Adobe 

Coach, mentor and develop a team of account executives to drive high performance 

• Advocate for customer insights and feedback to influence product enhancements and marketing positioning 

• Coordinate the full sales cycle and partner with Ops to drive business cadence that builds strong execution to deliver outcomes. 
 
What you need to succeed 

 

• A minimum of around 15 years of enterprise sales experience, including strong second line sales management experience. 

• Outstanding influencing, negotiation and commercial skills and executive presence 

• Validated big deal experience ($1mln +), and ideally complex CXO-level negotiations 

• Excellent relationship with C-level executives in many of Japan’s largest companies, across multiple sectors. 

• Consistent track record in leading through others within a matrixed organization. 

• Exceptional sales instincts with the ability to tune a sales engine for predictability, linearity and high performance. 

• Proven success in acquiring new business and ability to optimise and scale existing opportunities. 

• Excellent people leadership skills; ability to influence and drive accountability and ownership at all levels 

• Proficiency in using data to drive decision making and inspire change 

• Dedication diversity, equity, and inclusion at the heart of all you decide, do, and personify. Shown experience in developing and leading a high-performing regional team with a proven history of engaging and growing talent to greater responsibility and success. 

• Fluent in Japanese and proficient in verbal and written business-level English for professional purposes like reports, business reviews and negotiations, as well as at a level that allows for strong relationship-building with regional and global partners (internally and externally).

The Opportunity 

Adobe’s communications team helps define how the world understands Adobe by bringing our products, innovation, and customer and industry impact to life for media, creators, partners, and the broader market.

We are seeking an experienced media strategist to develop and drive integrated media relations programs that elevate Adobe’s leadership, innovation, and cultural relevance across traditional, digital, and emerging platforms. This role is for a strategic communicator who understands how influence is built in today’s evolving media ecosystem that spans top-tier press, broadcast, digital platforms, creator networks, podcasts, newsletters, and more!

Sitting within a broader communications team as part of Adobe’s global marketing organization, this role will architect and implement proactive storytelling programs. The ideal candidate will identify white space opportunities, craft compelling pitches, and secure high-impact placements to position Adobe and its leaders at the center of conversations about creativity, AI, digital work, and the future of expression.

What you'll Do 

Narrative Amplification: Develop and activate storytelling campaigns that position Adobe’s executives, product leaders, and subject matter experts as authoritative voices across creativity, AI, content, and productivity.

Proactive Media Engine: Identify white space opportunities across traditional and emerging platforms to drive sustained visibility and engagement.

Thought Leadership & Platform Development: Build multi-channel visibility programs that extend beyond interviews! This can be contributed content, speaking engagements, live and virtual events, social amplification, and strategic partnerships.

Executive & Spokesperson Advisor: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and spokespeople. Provide message development, interview preparation, platform strategy, and real-time counsel in high-visibility moments.

Media Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, producers, creators and influential voices that are shaping the creativity and technology landscape.

Insights & Measurement: Monitor industry trends, competitive positioning, and media performance to inform strategy. Identify emerging platforms and continuously optimize impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Adobe communications teams as well as Product Marketing and Social to ensure a unified company narrative across channels.

What you need to succeed 

8+ years of communications or media strategy experience, preferably in tech

Proven ability to build and execute integrated media campaigns across traditional and non-traditional channels

Strong network of business and technology media, including digital-first and emerging platforms

Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders or spokespeople in high-visibility situations

Exceptional writer and storyteller with ability to simplify and emotively express complex narratives

Highly collaborative, self-starter with expertise in managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

BA/BS degree in Communications, English, Public Relations, Journalism, Creative Writing, Political Science or related field (or equivalent experience)

Background, curiosity, and passion for software, technology, innovation, and creativity

Strong attention to detail

You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Hub and drive how creators discover, learn, and adopt Firefly across surfaces. This role partners closely with the Director of Growth and the Director of AI Content and manages a team of AI image and video content creators responsible for the projects that power Hub.

This role is an opportunity to define a world class onboarding and growth experience for AI powered creativity at Adobe.

What You’ll Do

Define and own the product vision for Firefly Hub as the primary onboarding, discovery, and growth surface for Firefly.

Lead the Hub product roadmap by identifying high impact growth opportunities, prioritizing features, defining success metrics, and supporting end to end delivery.

Build onboarding experiences that help users quickly understand, try, and succeed with Firefly products and workflows.

Ensure Firefly Hub operates seamlessly across web, mobile, and in product experiences inside Firefly apps and Adobe desktop applications.

Partner closely with the Director of Growth to align Hub experiences with activation, retention, and engagement strategies.

Partner closely with the Director of AI Content to plan, surface, and evolve example projects, tutorials, and quick actions.

Manage and lead a team of AI image and video content creators, setting direction, priorities, and quality standards for Hub content.

Translate complex AI capabilities into simple, approachable entry points that help users take their first and next steps.

Drive rapid iteration through experimentation, A B testing, and data informed decision making.

Share product direction and results with cross functional partners and senior leaders to align on growth priorities.

What’s Needed for Success

10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of growth, onboarding, or discovery experiences.

Deep experience in building world class onboarding experiences

Strong intuition for how creators learn new tools and develop confidence through guided experiences.

Strong analytical skills with experience defining and using metrics to drive product decisions.

A builder’s mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and learning through shipping.

Strong communication skills and ability to align cross functional partners around clear growth goals.

Adobe is seeking Applied Scientists who excel at turning research breakthroughs into innovative product features. Transform innovative research concepts into practical applications within the realm of Generative AI, LLMs, Reinforcement learning, Reasoning, Evaluations.

Collaborate with world-class researchers and ML engineers to bring research ideas to production.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Business Operations Lead to serve within the Ultimate Success team, within our strategic accounts segment, designed to deliver a differentiated, cross-functional engagement model.

In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone and decision enabler for senior leadership (Director+), driving alignment, governance, and performance visibility across strategy, data, programs, and delivery/resource management.

You will establish and own the operating model for the Signature Program—ensuring clear accountability, a unified reference point on program health, and disciplined execution across cross-functional collaborators. You will lead steering committees and executive forums for priority initiatives, framing decisions, driving closure, and ensuring commitments translate into measurable outcomes.

As a core member of this segment’s leadership team, you will bring structure to complexity, proactively surface risks and tradeoffs, and materially increase leadership effectiveness by reducing ambiguity, preventing surprises, and ensuring follow-through.

Examples of What You’ll Do

Own and Enforce the Signature Operating Model

Define, document, and continuously improve how the Signature Program operates (cadence, metrics, governance).

Act as the single source of truth for program, account, and initiative health.

Hold cross-functional collaborators accountable to agreed operating rhythms and commitments.

Enable Decisions and Drive Accountability

Guide steering committees and executive governance forums with clear objectives and outcomes.

Frame leadership conversations about decisions, options, tradeoffs, and implications.

Maintain decision logs and ensure follow-through is reflected in execution plans.

Deliver Actionable, Executive-Ready Insights

Drive requirements for decision-ready dashboards and work management systems

Deliver weekly summaries, priorities and QBRs

Translate data into clear narratives highlighting risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

Reconcile conflicting inputs into a single, trusted view of reality.

Drive Strategic Initiatives to Measurable Outcomes

Own tracking and inspection of critical Signature initiatives.

Ensure initiatives deliver measurable value, not just activity.

Improve workflows and adoption of AI and tooling to increase efficiency and clarity.

Align Resources and Investment to Business Impact

Oversee staffing, capacity, and delivery planning for the segment.

Partner with Finance to monitor headcount, travel, events, and contractor spend.

Connect resource and investment decisions to retention risk and revenue impact.

Internal Role Anchor

This role ensures our most critical customer programs never fail due to lack of clarity, alignment, or follow-through.

The Opportunity

Adobe Cloud Platform & Collaboration (ACPC) builds the cloud infrastructure behind Photoshop, Firefly, Express, and other creative tools used by millions every day. We're looking for a Cloud Software Engineer who wants to take ownership of services that creative professionals around the world rely on.

You'll join a team of four to nine engineers that designs, builds, and operates microservices at scale across multiple cloud regions. We follow a "You build it, you own it" philosophy, meaning you'll have real responsibility from architecture through production. You'll collaborate with teams in Hamburg, the US, and India, working on problems where reliability, security, and performance matter every day.

What you'll Do

Develop and operate Java microservices that power Adobe’s cloud platform, supporting a large global audience

Improve the performance, reliability, and security of services your team owns end-to-end

Apply modern engineering practices and AI-assisted tooling to make development faster and more productive

Raise the quality bar through code reviews, testing strategies, and thoughtful system design

Work closely with your team and collaborate across engineering and product organizations

Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, shared ownership, and open collaboration across teams

What you need to succeed

5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally in cloud-native environments

Strong programming skills in Java; additionally, Go or C++ would be a plus

Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservice architectures, and cloud platforms such as AWS

Hands-on experience with Spring, RESTful APIs, and NoSQL databases like MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB

Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk

Clear communication skills in German and English

Curious about modern development practices, including AI-assisted development and automation

What We Offer You

Real impact at scale: your work directly enables millions of users to create and collaborate

Ownership and autonomy over the services you build, from design through production

A global, diverse team that brings different perspectives to hard problems

2–3 on-site team days per week at our Hamburg office at the Fish Market, with flexibility to work from home

Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding team, where you can take on more responsibility over time

Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, Sales Process Owner to lead and deliver global Sales process and systems transformation at scale. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role designed for an individual with deep expertise in Sales process transformation across multiple SaaS companies, who is excited to own outcomes as part of Sales at Adobe!

The Process Owner brings a strong external perspective on what "great" looks like in modern SaaS Sales, paired with the ability to pragmatically apply that expertise in a complex, real-world environment. This role is accountable for understanding the Sales business end to end, translating strategy and seller needs into future-state process and capability designs, and ensuring those designs are delivered through systems, data, and enablement.

This role serves as the voice of Sales to IT, representing seller requirements and business priorities while partnering closely with technology leaders to deliver scalable capabilities. The Process Owner manages the capability roadmap within their Sales process domain. This includes process, systems, data, and personas. They lead a team responsible for completing that roadmap!

Key Responsibilities

Sales Process Transformation & Ownership

Own and transform end-to-end Sales processes within a process domain (such as opportunity management & forecasting or renewals and customer base expansion)

Develop a deep understanding of Sales strategy, operating models, seller workflows, and business requirements.

Be accountable for process outcomes including seller productivity, speed, data quality, compliance, and customer experience.

Future-State Design & Roadmap Management

Design the future-state Sales processes and capabilities aligned to company growth strategy and go-to-market motions.

Own and manage the capability roadmap for assigned Sales process areas, inclusive of process, systems, data, and personas.

Identify gaps between current state and future state and sequence initiatives to drive meaningful transformation.

Balance standardization, scalability, and flexibility across regions, segments, and routes to market.

Business Requirements & Technology Partnership

Represent the voice of Sales with IT, Product, and Engineering teams.

Translate Sales business needs and future-state designs into clear, prioritized business requirements and success criteria.

Partner with IT to deliver capabilities that enable Sales processes through CRM, automation, analytics, and AI.

Ensure delivered solutions meet Sales needs and drive adoption and measurable impact.

Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

Partner with Sales Leadership to align process transformation priorities to revenue goals.

Collaborate with Sales Ops / RevOps, Legal, Finance, Product, and IT to ensure processes are executable, compliant, and scalable.

Act as a senior leader and decision-maker when tradeoffs arise between speed, control, and scale.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a team of process architects and business analysts

Set clear goals, accountability, and development plans for the team.

Establish consistent standards, methodologies, and ways of working for Sales process design and delivery.

Governance, Adoption & Measurement

Establish and lead governance forums to review roadmap progress, prioritize investments, and manage risk.

Define benchmarks and success metrics to evaluate Sales process efficiency and transformation progress.

Inspire change management, enablement, and communication to ensure strong adoption by sellers and managers.

Qualifications

10–12+ years of progressive experience leading Sales process and systems transformation within SaaS companies and/or management consulting.

Demonstrated experience delivering multiple, large-scale Sales process transformations, preferably as a management consultant serving SaaS or technology clients, or as a process architect or owner across multiple SaaS companies.

Deep expertise in end-to-end SaaS Sales processes and operating models, including enterprise, mid-market, SMB, and partner-led motions.

Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear future-state process designs and executable roadmaps.

Strong experience defining business requirements and partnering with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver CRM and Sales technology capabilities.

Hands-on expertise with CRM platforms (Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics) and adjacent Sales technologies.

Experience influencing and aligning senior Sales leaders and executives without direct authority.

Prior people management experience, including leading teams through complex change.

Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to represent Sales credibly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM

Prior experience at a leading management consulting firm dedicated to Sales, Revenue Operations, or commercial transformation.

Experience transitioning from consulting into an internal transformation or process owner role.

Experience leading global Sales process standardization across regions.

Familiarity with business architecture frameworks, value streams, and capability modeling.

Experience using AI, automation, and analytics to transform Sales execution.

Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process excellence certification.

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; MBA preferred.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This role is ideal for a former or current management consultant who has led multiple Sales or commercial transformations for SaaS or technology clients and is now looking to:

Move from advisory work into a role with direct ownership and accountability for outcomes

Apply proven transformation frameworks while adapting them pragmatically inside one organization

Act as a senior thought partner to Sales leaders, not just a process executor

Shape how Sales operates at scale, rather than optimizing around the edges

The Opportunity

The Adobe Customer Solutions Engagement Manager leads substantial, innovative engagements for critical Adobe accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic guide, you help Sales and Delivery teams align projects with customers’ objectives. Recognized as a business contributor and delivery specialist, you are the primary customer contact in a billable capacity. You drive the delivery of desired results while preserving strong executive connections.

This position merges excellent delivery and client relationship supervision, concentrating on client and partner communication, cross-functional teamwork, and technical skills to advance business transformation. Success requires collaborating across people, process, and technology with an industry or customer practitioner perspective to produce measurable customer value.

What You'll Do

Customer Engagement & Delivery Leadership

The role manages the success of a defined set of strategic Services customers in the region. It ensures customer requirements are met and that engagements deliver measurable business value aligned to customer priorities. It acts as the primary contact for customer executives and coordinates with partners across the customer’s broader ecosystem. After contract booking, it ensures a smooth and efficient transition from Sales to Delivery. It works closely with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to align on customer success plans and find opportunities to drive value across Adobe solutions. It serves as the main point of contact at senior management level, resolving customer issues quickly and keeping engagements on track.

Operational Excellence

You are responsible for driving accurate and effective revenue management, including growth and margin execution, revenue acceleration, backlog burn, contract expiration and extension management, and close alignment with Adobe Finance and Operations.

You manage the Services team by coordinating team staffing, onboarding, and transitions within the assigned account(s).

Services Expansion & Opportunity Development

You will partner closely with Adobe Sales to build new services opportunities and support contract extensions, change requests, and addendum. You contribute strategic feedback to account planning in collaboration with the wider account teams, and lead efforts to renew and expand Customer Solutions relationships with existing clients by demonstrating a deep understanding of customer objectives and the scope, activities, and resources required to achieve them.

What you'll need to succeed

8+ years of hands-on experience in professional services, consulting or customer delivery experience of large programs, preferably in SaaS or enterprise software.

Experience with enterprise level project or program management.

Proven track record of building positive relationships, managing complex customer engagements and leading transformation.

Passion for operational rigor and customer value, with a proven ability to collaborate, lead and influence in a matrixed organization.

Strong business insight and industry expertise with ability to speak to value drivers and use cases in customer's context via experience-based story telling.

Ability to effectively navigate complex client situations and act as a change agent for our clients and within Adobe Services.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, executive level presence and experience in working in a client advisory role.

Able to travel to support client engagements.

Bachelor’s degree, with an MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

Digital marketing experience is preferred.

Minimum Qualifications

Job Description

Position Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity to join the India COE team as we continue to shift to drive the business through data-driven forecasts and providing influential insights. This Senior Financial Analyst position will partner with the Finance Manager at HQ to support reporting and analysis for one of the verticals in the CXO organization. In this role, you will be responsible for a wide range of projects in support of key business decisions and fiscal deliverable. You will develop and maintain frameworks for quarterly & annual budgets, drive consolidation of in-quarter outlook forecast, analyze and report on financial data, partner with geographically dispersed finance colleagues, and provide recommendations to management.

Responsibilities include:

Prepare reporting for annual/quarterly budgets and weekly/monthly forecasts, ensuring a high level of headcount and expense predictability for the identified organization, review for completeness and summarize key variances

Prepare trended analytics for key areas such as headcount attrition, employee costs, and travel spend

Generate outlook and controller’s letter reporting

Leverage Power BI/Tableau to create and maintain centralized and common reporting and analytical solutions

Prepare journal entries, reconcile balance sheet accounts and quarterly international charge outs

Drive continual process improvements, framework enhancements in support of generating meaningful data-driven insights

Collaborate with finance controllers/consolidators to drive fiscal deliverable, gain comprehension of variance drivers, and challenge assumptions/methodologies employed

Ad-hoc analysis as required, and self-initiated projects encouraged

Requirements:

Positive attitude and comfort in an environment subject to change as the business evolves

Bachelor's degree in business, finance or related field; CPA/MBA/Chartered Accountant preferred, but not mandatory

10+ years of FP&A (or related) experience required, preferably with a US-based company

Strong analytical and accounting skills; must understand key business drivers, ability to communicate financial implications/business impact and provide recommendations with attention to detail

Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

Ability to take charge, set objectives, drive to results

Exceptional follow-through capabilities

Willingness and ability to quickly master new tools and processes

Advanced Excel skills are essential, and experience in Tableau and Anaplan are preferred. SFDC, SAP, TM1 and PowerPoint are also useful.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Designer to define the future of human–AI collaboration across Adobe’s ecosystem. This role focuses on agentic systems operating across complex creative and enterprise workflows. You will shape the interaction paradigms that govern delegation, control, evaluation, and trust.

This is a systems design role focused on AI behavior, orchestration, and adaptive interfaces. We are looking for a designer who works directly with models, prototypes in code, and treats AI systems as a design material.

What you’ll do

This role demands a systems thinker operating across strategy and implementation. You will define interaction paradigms, prototype AI behaviors, and align research, engineering, and design around a coherent vision.

Define New Interaction Paradigms for Agentic Systems

Establish mental models for delegation, collaboration, and control between humans and AI agents.

Design interaction frameworks for multi-step workflows and tool-using systems.

Define how users inspect reasoning, guide autonomous behavior, and balance prompt-based and structured interaction.

Design for Trust, Transparency & Evaluation

Create mechanisms that make AI reasoning legible, including confidence indicators, provenance, and evaluation UX.

Design failure recovery and escalation models.

Contribute to guardrails that balance capability with safety.

Prototype AI-Native Experiences

Work directly with large language models and agent frameworks.

Write and refine prompts, skills, system instructions, and behavioral constraints to shape system behavior.

Prototype using code, scripting, or AI tooling.

Rapidly iterate through build → test → refine cycles in close partnership with research and engineering.

Shape Context-Aware & Brand-Aware Systems

Design systems that understand creative context, enterprise constraints, memory, and personalization.

Contribute to the evolution of AI-native components within Adobe’s design system.

Drive Strategic & Org-Level Impact

Influence senior leadership through compelling system visions and working prototypes.

Align cross-functional teams around AI interaction strategy.

Mentor designers working in emerging AI spaces and elevate the craft of behavior design across the organization.

What you'll bring

We are redefining what it means to be a designer at the Principal level in the age of AI.

Core Experience

10+ years of experience in product, systems, or interaction design.

Demonstrated experience defining and shipping AI-native or agent-based systems.

Experience designing for creative tools or deep familiarity with creative workflows and processes.

Deep systems thinking with experience designing platforms or complex workflows.

Hands-on experience working with large language models and designing adaptive or generative interfaces, including dynamic UI, tool selection, and orchestration layers.

Comfort prototyping in code and contributing production-quality implementations alongside engineering teams.

Experience driving cross-functional alignment on ambiguous, emerging technology initiatives.

Additional Depth

Experience designing enterprise AI workflows.

Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns.

Experience integrating first- and third-party AI systems.

Background in automation design, developer tooling, or platform ecosystems.

Accessibility expertise in AI-driven interfaces.

Preferred Accessibility Design Skills:

Experience designing accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities.

Understanding of applying WCAG conformance criteria in design, specifically testing comps, wireframes, and prototypes for accessibility standards.

Accessibility certifications CPACC, WAS, CPWA, or ADS from the IAAP preferred.

You think in behaviors, systems, and capabilities, not just screens, flows, and features.

You treat AI systems as a design material. You’ve built AI workflows or agent prototypes and understand how model behavior shifts under constraint, how tools are invoked, and how memory and guardrails shape outcomes.

You are energized by ambiguity. Designing agentic systems means working with emergent behavior and evolving systems. Rather than waiting for clarity, you create it through prototypes and collaboration with research and engineering.

You are opinionated about the future of AI-native workflows and excited to help shape new ways of working. Most importantly, you believe AI should expand human creativity and capability. You design systems that empower people, not replace them.

How to apply

To be considered for this role, please submit your resume and portfolio. We’re especially interested in systems you’ve defined, AI workflows you’ve built, and evidence of working directly with intelligent systems.

As a Firefly Product Specialist at Adobe, you will support and sell Adobe Firefly Enterprise Solutions across Enterprise accounts. This role will partner with Account Directors (ADs) to help grow the existing business through identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities. This role requires solution selling capabilities, experience selling value to customers, strong business and selling instincts, and direct, in-person consultation with customers. The Firefly Product Specialist is responsible for guiding and navigating through an enterprise organization to ensure a successful sales cycle, start to finish. As Product Specialist, you will play a crucial role in pushing the boundaries of digital creativity and empowering artists and designers to build awe-inspiring content.

Responsibilities:

Sales Field Alignment – Work with Adobe Sales Team across the Digital Media (DMe) and Digital Experience (DX) to support Multi-Product Enterprise Solutions, Strategic Firefly-only Solutions or as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for general Firefly sales engagements. Be the Firefly and GenAI expert for your area, improving scale and sales efficiency in creative GenAI projects.

Account Planning – Develop targeted account strategies and tactical penetration plans.

Relationship Management – Develop and maintain relationships at the “C-Suite” and “VP” levels within targeted accounts. Relationships will be with both IT and Business segments of the enterprise.

Build & Develop Pipeline – Identify cross-sell opportunities through targeted whitespace analysis, partner with pre-sales to drive maturity and sales stage progression in preparation for in-quarter execution.

Deliver Product Presentations – Understand customer needs and solution fit by delivering effective product demonstrations, use cases, positioning differentiated value/vision, and sales pitches. Develop Arguments – Develop strong Creative GenAI arguments that emphasize compelling differentiated value proposition, thought leadership, and return on investment cost/benefit analysis.

Coordinate Resource Expertise – Own coordination of pre-sales, product and commercial expertise in the sales cycle while project managing key deliverables to an established timeline.

Close Sales – Build proposals, negotiate contract pricing & contractual agreement to close sale.

Qualifications:

Minimum 7+ years proven track record of enterprise-level, technical solution direct sales expertise within a more sophisticated sales model is required. 10+ years of experience highly preferred.

Proven experience consulting and selling digital transformation and enterprise solutions to “C-Suite” executives and overachieving on quotas is required.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, capable of working effectively in cross-functional teams and explaining technical concepts to non-technical collaborators.

Experience working with Adobe Creative Cloud products (i.e., Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects) or Adobe Experience Cloud products (i.e., AEM, AEP) is a plus.

Knowledge of generative AI technologies, including deep learning, neural networks, and generative models would be great!

Proficient in creative workflows and the design process, capable of seeing opportunities for integrating generative AI techniques.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative solutions to complex challenges.

Ability to travel upwards of 50%.

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.

If you are passionate about the intersection of AI and creativity, and you thrive in a dynamic and innovative environment, we encourage you to apply. Join our team and help **craft** the future of digital creativity with Adobe's generative AI capabilities.

The Opportunity 

The Adobe Content Platform & Collaboration (ACPC) is the cloud foundation that enables millions of people to create, store, and collaborate on creative content every day. 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep experience building cloud‑native systems to help evolve this globally distributed foundation. In this role, you’ll work on backend services operating at massive scale, with high expectations for reliability, security, and performance. 

You’ll join a collaborative team based in Hamburg, working closely with colleagues in the US and India, and contribute to capabilities used across Adobe products like Photoshop, Acrobat, Illustrator, Firefly, and Express. 

What you’ll do 

Design, build, and operate Java‑based cloud services, owning them from design through production 

Evolve scalable, secure, and reliable capabilities using modern cloud and distributed systems practices 

Improve system performance, resilience, and operability across multiple cloud regions 

Strengthen engineering quality through clear design, collaborative code reviews, and effective testing 

Work closely with partner teams that build on our services 

What you need to succeed 

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend or platform focus 

Strong Java programming skills and a solid understanding of distributed systems 

Hands‑on experience with cloud‑native services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

Experience diagnosing and resolving issues in large‑scale, production systems 

Strong communication skills in English (German is a plus) 

Curiosity to learn and apply new technologies, including AI‑assisted development 

Why you’ll enjoy working with us 

Build cloud platform software that empowers everyone to create, trusted by customers around the world and designed to work reliably at global scale 

Hybrid work model – 2-3 on‑site team days per week at our Hamburg office near the Fish Market, with flexibility to work from home 

Inclusive, collaborative culture – We learn together, treat mistakes as opportunities to grow, and focus on outcomes, not heroes: success is a team effort 

If this role excites you, but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value the perspective you bring and how you approach problems – not checking every box.

Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with a passion for mentoring and fostering a culture of creativity and excellence.

The Opportunity

Join a team that works across Sales and GTM, to operationalize promotional and pricing initiatives, globally, across all offerings, for all of Adobe’s routes-to-markets. Lead a versatile team to develop, improve and maintain Promotional and Pricing programs supporting Adobe and its RTM/GTM teams. Support the team in addressing technical issues with promo offer creation, and delivery workflows, through outstanding mentorship. Guide the team to enhance processes and infrastructure.

What you’ll do:

Manage an independent team supporting Adobe Sales and Marketing delivering promotional and pricing initiatives across different routes-to-market and offerings. This includes Adobe.com, ICX/Phones, Channel and Corporate.

Partner with the Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product teams, Engineering, Fraud and Legal, to understand the promo and pricing delivery requirements.

Own the end-to-end intake and governance pathway for promotions (from request intake through approvals), ensuring requests are complete, compliant, and ready for execution

Run the cross RTM promo planning cadence (Promo Pod): consolidate promo asks, drive alignment, and operationalize outcomes into an executable promo plan and schedule.

Partner with Analytics to enable evidence-based challenge/adjudication of promo proposals (e.g., cannibalization / switching insights).

Guide Sales/GTM requester teams on requirements, documentation, and approval routing for the PAR (Pricing Action Request) process to reduce rework and prevent last‑minute issues.

Ensure end-to-end operational readiness for promos across surfaces (e.g., Adobe.com + other routes-to-market), including workflow testing and dependency management.

Coordinate all aspects of the key promotional initiatives globally to consistently achieve results in an ambiguous and changing environment. This includes large scale initiatives such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Back to School, etc.

Be a major player in process improvement and a motivator for building mature processes. Build and maintain a central repository for planning and execution documentation including Confluence/Wiki, SharePoint, etc.

Lead standardization and reusability efforts (templates, briefs, documented SOPs) to reduce cycle time and improve global consistency.

Sponsor/drive automation initiatives (RPA/AI/API-first where applicable), translating operational problems into clear requirements and measurable benefits.

Manage demand and prioritization across promo asks, balancing speed, risk, and value; establish visibility through simple dashboards/operational metrics.

What you need to succeed:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Outstanding collaboration skills and ability to work across various business units and job levels to complete on a project with tight deadlines.

Project / Program Management experience

Strong program management rigor (plans, achievements, alignment) to deliver complex initiatives consistently.

Strong understanding of various business process improvement methodologies. An appreciate of how Automation / RPA / AI can be used to improve processes, and where ‘keeping humans-in-the-loop’ is required

Demonstrated controls approach (risk, audit readiness, governance), with ability to run structured approval workflows and ensure compliance requirements are met.

Change Management: a strong Change Manager with tenacity to follow through till closure.

Leadership: outstanding leadership and communications skills required to manage multiple teams, routes-to-market and programs simultaneously.

Experience leading globally distributed teams and partners; strong global/cultural awareness.

Technical expertise: Knowledge of Adobe systems and platforms required to operationalize promotional workflows and customer journeys for the individual and B2B businesses, across both direct and indirect routes-to-market, an advantage.

The Challenge

The Senior Project Manager leads client-focused initiatives to implement Adobe Marketing Cloud solutions. Collaborating at multiple levels with the Adobe Global Services and Field Sales teams and various key customers and partners, this strategic role leads every phase of project planning. This covers defining the project scope, planning, monitoring timelines, and prioritizing resources. The position partners closely with the Adobe Delivery team to coordinate the technical implementation. The Senior Project Manager directly impacts revenue from Adobe customers and will collaborate as required to maintain a positive customer experience. This role requires strong multi-tasking ability, proactive and efficient communication, and the skill to bring up critical issues while providing solutions to customers.

This role is preferred to be filled from an Adobe office. Desired locations include San Jose, San Francisco, and New York. There is some flexibility to also consider Chicago, Austin, Seattle, or McLean, VA.

What You'll Do

Work with customer(s) and Adobe Field and Services Sales teams to clearly define project scope, requirements, and integration points. Document these details as they relate to solution implementation.

Coordinate project delivery process with key contributors to help manage scope and prepare change requests - including tasks, deliverables, achievements, resources, and estimated costs. Act as primary point of contact for the client(s) throughout the project lifecycle.

Achieve customer happiness through successful delivery of defined project scope. Coordinate and communicate critical issues across Adobe – including Field Sales, the Services Customer Engagement, and Product teams.

Manage administrative portions of project delivery from inception to closure.

Collaborate with third-party subcontractors, vendors and technology partners as needed.

Capture and communicate experiences in formal retrospectives - relaying guidelines, customer experience, and resource feedback to the larger Adobe Services Customer Engagement practice.

Coordinate critical issues across Adobe including sales, custom services, and product organizations.

Accurately forecast revenue, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization across projects.

Identifies partnership opportunities and capitalizes on “add-on” sales opportunities across projects.

What You Need to Succeed

Minimum 8 – 10 years of previous experience in a client-facing project management position, preferably within the Digital Marketing Cloud domain. This encompasses familiarity with Web Content Management, Rich internet applications, Web & Social Analytics, online Ad Targeting, and content Personalization solutions.

8 – 10 years of demonstrated achievement in a software-focused PM position is strongly preferred. Previous experience as a project manager in a SaaS setting is required.

Proven ability to understand the impact of technical changes and to articulate high level technical solutions to address business problems.

Excellent problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to identify issues, resolve them quickly and know when to rely on internal resources to assist.

An innovative thinker, collaborative business partner, who is well-organized and detailed with strong presentation and reporting skills is required.

Professional demeanor, ability to interact with and lead diverse teams throughout Adobe, and communicating with client managers, directors, and VPs including CMOs and CXOs.

Strong verbal, presentation and written communication skills as well as strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills.

Deep understanding of custom software development processes and engagement strategies. Hands-on experience managing agile development projects is beneficial.

Ability to manage in an environment of ambiguity with diverse collaborators.

Ability to build positive relationships and generate opportunities for repeat business.

Willingness to travel up to 60%.

BS/BA degree required and MS/MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

Highly Desired

Experience as Consulting Manager in a large consulting organization or Agency.

Experience coordinating Agile development projects.

Previous experience with Adobe Digital Marketing Solutions.

Previous experience with Financial Force.

Proven experience managing off-shore teams.

PMP certification and Certified ScrumMaster is preferred.

Design and build data processing pipelines using Java / Scala and Spark

Collaborate with engineers, architects, and product teams across Adobe Analytics

Examples of technologies used across the platform include:

Java / JVM ecosystem

Databricks

Kafka and distributed data pipelines

5+ years of backend or data platform engineering experience

Strong expertise in Java or Scala

Experience with Spark or large-scale data processing frameworks

Experience working with cloud infrastructure

Nice to Have

Experience working with Databricks

Experience contributing to architecture decisions and mentoring engineers

Solve data processing and distributed systems challenges

Build systems powering real-time customer journey analytics

Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global engineering teams

Distributed data processing frameworks

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Staff Designer to lead the design and delivery of intelligent agentic systems across complex creative and enterprise workflows. This role focuses on building and shipping AI-native capabilities that enable users to delegate, steer, and evaluate intelligent systems with confidence.

This is a systems design role focused on AI behavior, orchestration, and adaptive interfaces. We are looking for a designer who works directly with models, prototypes in code, and treats AI systems as a design material.

What you’ll do

You will lead major initiatives within our agentic systems work, translating emerging AI capabilities into production-ready interaction patterns and driving a coherent vision across research, engineering, and product.

Design and Ship Agentic Interaction Systems

Establish mental models for delegation, collaboration, and control between humans and AI agents.

Design interaction frameworks for multi-step workflows and tool-using skills.

Design mechanisms that make reasoning legible, including confidence indicators, provenance, and evaluation UX.

Build patterns that balance prompt-based and structured interaction.

Prototype and Deliver AI-Native Capabilities

Work directly with large language models and agent frameworks.

Write and refine prompts, skills, system instructions, and behavioral constraints.

Prototype in code and contribute to production implementations alongside engineering.

Rapidly iterate through build → test → refine cycles in close partnership with research and engineering.

Adapt AI Systems to Creative Contexts

Design systems that understand creative workflows, enterprise constraints, memory, and personalization.

Ensure agent behaviors align with real creative processes and tooling needs.

Contribute to the evolution of AI-native components within Adobe’s design system.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Partner closely with engineering, research, and product to deliver production systems.

Influence stakeholders through working prototypes and clear system articulation.

Contribute to shared best practices for AI interaction and behavior design.

What you'll bring

We are redefining what it means to be a designer in the age of AI.

Core Experience

8+ years of experience in product, systems, or interaction design.

Demonstrated experience designing and shipping AI-assisted or agent-based systems.

Experience designing for creative tools or deep familiarity with creative workflows.

Hands-on experience working with large language models and designing adaptive or generative interfaces.

Comfort prototyping in code and contributing production-quality implementations alongside engineering teams.

Strong systems thinking and experience working within complex, cross-functional environments.

Additional Depth

Experience designing enterprise AI workflows.

Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns.

Experience integrating first- and third-party AI systems.

Background in automation design, developer tooling, or platform ecosystems.

Accessibility expertise in AI-driven interfaces.

Preferred Accessibility Design Skills:

Experience designing accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities.

Understanding of applying WCAG conformance criteria in design, specifically testing comps, wireframes, and prototypes for accessibility standards.

Accessibility certifications CPACC, WAS, CPWA, or ADS from the IAAP preferred.

You think in behaviors, systems, and capabilities, not just screens, flows, and features.

You treat AI systems as a design material and have built workflows or prototypes that explore model behavior under real constraints.

You are energized by ambiguity and motivated to shape how AI becomes a practical, trusted collaborator in creative work.

Most importantly, you believe AI should expand human creativity and capability, not replace it.

How to apply

To be considered for this role, please submit your resume and portfolio. We’re especially interested in systems you’ve defined, AI workflows you’ve built, and evidence of working directly with intelligent systems.

Job Title: Principal Value Consultant

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic Value Consultant dedicated to advancing the development of our Value Consulting organization at Adobe. This role emphasizes building compelling arguments to demonstrate the value of Adobe Firefly Services and solutions to prospective clients while driving sales and customer adoption. The ideal candidate will possess a solid grasp of software sales processes, value-based selling, and have experience translating technical features into business benefits. They will also have a solid understanding of go-to-market and business skills to help customers understand how to use Adobe software to drive business outcomes and present to influencers as well as executive decision makers.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Business Cases: Work with sales teams, including Account Executives, Solution Consultants, and Solution Architects. Build detailed arguments to demonstrate the return on investment and value of our software solutions. 

Design Value Frameworks: Refine frameworks for value consulting that can be consistently applied across different products and client scenarios.

Client Engagement: Work directly with clients to understand their needs and challenges, in order to articulate how Adobe solutions can create measurable value for their business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product management, marketing, and leadership to ensure alignment on value messaging and capability. Gather insights that inform argument development.

Training and Enablement: Create and deliver training sessions for sales teams to enhance their understanding of Value Consulting methodologies and to equip them with tools for effective client engagement.

Metrics and Reporting: Help develop and support objective and key results to measure the effectiveness of value consulting initiatives and provide data for regular reports to senior management on progress and outcomes.

We are looking for a recently qualified or early-career lawyer (0–2 years PQE) admitted to the Bar Association, eager to build their in-house career and make a meaningful contribution to our operations within the Central (Eastern Europe) and Iberia (Spain and Portugal) regions. Why Join Us?

A Legal Team Like No Other: Supportive, encouraging, and—above all—friendly. We lift each other up, share knowledge freely, and always find time to celebrate wins (big or small).

Diversity & Inclusion: We champion every voice, celebrate every background, and believe that brilliant ideas come from everywhere.

Work/Life Balance: We know life is more than work. Flexible schedules and hybrid options are here to keep you energized.

Competitive Salary & Benefits: A comprehensive compensation package intended to support and reward employees.

Growth & Opportunity: Adobe is rapidly growing, and so can you. Structured mentoring and a clear development path are built into this role. Get involved in crafting new systems (think: AI chatbots, CLM, knowledge sharing, automation) and work processes.

The challenge 

Build your in-house legal career by supporting our dynamic sales team and working alongside colleagues in marketing, finance, procurement, and beyond. Under the guidance of our Managing Counsel, you will develop into a trusted legal partner for the Central and Iberia Regions.

What You’ll Do

Draft, Review & Negotiate: Work and negotiate on a variety of agreements—license, professional services, consulting, statements of work, resale, distribution, sales, and licensing. You’ll keep us covered and keep deals moving.

Commercial Legal Support: Partner with our business units, providing timely, commercial advice and delivering in-house training on the legal topics that matter most. Help demystify law for your colleagues!

Compliance Monitor: Monitor and flag relevant regulatory and legal developments — particularly in technology, AI, intellectual property, and data privacy — and support senior counsel in analysing their impact on Adobe.

Drive Process Improvement: Dive into knowledge management and help evolve our legal processes. Lead departmental projects that make us better, smarter, and faster.

Embrace Legal Technology: Use AI-assisted tools for contract analysis, research, and document drafting as part of your day-to-day workflow. Develop hands-on fluency in the technologies that are reshaping how legal services are delivered — no prior experience required, just a genuine curiosity about what’s coming next.

Project Legal Support: Join working groups as new projects and business practices are developed, bringing your legal and business perspective where it’s needed most.

Ongoing Training & Risk Management: Carry out internal training sessions, and offer continuous support on key risks—building a culture of compliance and confidence.

What you need to succeed

Qualified Lawyer: Admitted to the Bar Association with 0–2 years PQE. In-house or law firm experience is welcome; we are equally open to recently qualified candidates who are the right fit.

Commercial/IT/IP Interest: You have foundational knowledge or a strong interest in commercial, technology, or IP law — gained through studies, internships, or early practice. You have an appetite to deepen your understanding of the complexities of software, technology, and data protection in a fast-moving tech company.

Business and Risk Savvy: You see the bigger picture and understand how legal matters fit into business objectives, assess, and manage risks across multiple matters at once.

Communication Skills: You have strong drafting ability and good attention to detail, and you can translate complex legalese into everyday plain language.

Languages: Proficient in English and Romanian (required). Spanish or Portuguese is a genuine advantage given the Iberia scope of the role.

Flexible & Adaptable: You’re quick on your feet, ready to adjust when the business demands change.

What Makes This Role Fun & Cool?

Build the Future: Play a key role in Adobe’s evolution, especially in this fast-paced tech and AI culture.

Tech Meets Law: Dive into brand new systems and technology incorporating AI, CLM, and automation—assist us in scaling smarter!

Room to Grow: Take on new challenges, lead projects, collaborate with a distributed team, and develop your own expertise as Adobe expands.

Fun Perks: Celebrations, creativity challenges, and team-building events—plus some of the best colleagues in the business.

Lead, mentor, and support a high-performing engineering team. Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance discussions, and career growth conversations. Build a collaborative, inclusive team culture with guidance from senior leadership.

Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, design sessions, and technical planning to uphold high standards of code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.

Track team velocity, quality metrics, and system health; facilitate retrospectives and drive continuous improvement with support from leadership.

Handle sprint/quarter planning, resource coordination, risk identification, and delivery commitments for platform work.

Remain informed about progress in Vue.js, Node.js/Fastify, analytics databases (ClickHouse), caching (Redis), container platforms (Azure Container Apps), AI-assisted development, and data trends to support team decisions.

5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on work in frontend and backend technologies (e.g., Vue.js or similar modern JS frameworks + Node.js/TypeScript).

The Challenge

Adobe is looking for an Account Director who is responsible for achieving sales targets through the sale of Adobe’s Digital Marketing product lines. As a part of our enterprise sales team, working with Adobe’s largest customers across the Manufacturing industry. The Account Director will achieve this through software solution selling capabilities and direct, face-to-face contact with the customer. Responsibilities include building relationships at all levels with a focus on c-suite, and effectively navigating the customer's organization. You will guide and assist customers in achieving a successful start with Adobe and help them expand the value realized from our solution. Do you value extraordinary benefits, and one of the best places to work in the world?

Communicate with customers effectively and persuasively to uncover company-viable solutions from their view.

Build strong executive relationships across multiple fields (CIO, CTO, CMO, CDO).

Identify and gain alignment from customer on compelling business issue to be addressed.

Demonstrate industry expertise, thought leadership, grasp of macro-economic environment and be a trusted advisor.

Articulate the Adobe story, unique value proposition and how Adobe’s solutions align with customer’s vision and solve customer’s business issue (e.g. return on investment of product).

Identify and lead collaboration with external 3rd parties including tech partners and system integrators.

Meet sales quota and run efficient business

Advance and close sales opportunities - through the successful execution of the sales strategy and roadmap.

Build strong account plans at the beginning of the year and lead regular account planning meetings to keep team aligned.

Ideal candidate will have:

Minimum 5 to 7+ years with proven track record selling solutions to Marketing, IT, and brands or lines of business in large enterprise organizations;

Ability to work effectively in a team environment, optimally partnering with other Adobe teams including Sales, Support, Engineering, Product & Marketing;

Strong understanding of digital experience technologies and SaaS within the MFG space;

Validated Sales Excellence and creative, problem-solving approach

Job Description- Enterprise Architect

Position Summary

As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will define and deliver enterprise scale digital

experience architectures that leverage Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML capabilities, and

modern cloud platforms. You will partner with senior business and technology leaders to

shape strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable customer

and business outcomes.

You will combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI, data, and cloud-native

experience to design future-ready solutions: from customer data foundations and decisioning

to personalized, omnichannel experiences. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through

digital, data, and AI transformation, ensuring alignment between business goals, technology

investments, and delivery teams.

Success in this role is measured by customer value and adoption, quality and feasibility of

architectures, clarity of roadmaps, impact on KPIs, and depth of trusted relationships rather

than billable hours alone.

The Opportunity

Digital is disrupting traditional business models and reshaping every stage of the customer

lifecycle. Leading organizations are turning to Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-powered

experiences to stay ahead.

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team is a dynamic group of senior consultants who:

• Partner with executives to define digital, data, and AI strategies.

• Design integrated architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation.

• Help clients adopt cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven patterns on platforms such

as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, and public cloud

providers.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will use your knowledge of digital marketing technology,

AI/ML capabilities, and enterprise architecture to:

• Create strategic roadmaps for digital experience and AI innovation.

• Lead clients as a subject matter expert.

• Serve as a trusted advisor across business, data, and technology stakeholders.

What you'll Do

• Shape digital, data, and AI strategy

o Partner with executive and senior client stakeholders to define digital experience,

customer data, and AI/ML goals.

o Translate business vision into actionable multi-year architecture roadmaps

encompassing Adobe solutions, data/ML platforms, and cloud services.

o Identify key business drivers, KPIs, and value hypotheses to prioritize use cases

(e.g., personalization, journey orchestration, next-best action, marketing

optimization).

• Design enterprise and solution architectures

o Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client

ecosystems.

o Define AI- and data-centric architectures, including: Customer data platforms,

identity, and profile management.

o Data ingestion, quality, governance, and activation patterns. Recommend futurestate

technology architectures using cloud-native principles (API-first,

microservices, event-driven, serverless) across Azure, AWS, and/or other public

clouds.

o Define reference architectures and patterns for secure, scalable cloud

deployments. Zero-trust, identity, and access management. Observability and

reliability.

• Drive alignment and governance

o Ensure alignment between business strategies, enterprise architecture, and

delivery teams across marketing, product, data, and IT.

o Define governance, operating models, and ways of working (e.g., architecture

review processes, decision forums, standards) to support sustainable adoption of

Adobe capabilities.

o Act as a liaison between Adobe teams, client business owners, IT, data/analytics,

and external partners for the full lifecycle of the engagement.

• Communicate and evangelize

o Communicate architecture options, trade-offs, and recommendations to C-level

and senior leadership using clear narratives, visuals, and value framing.

o Lead workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations that evangelize

AI and data driven digital experiences.

o Advocate for the Enterprise Architecture function and your work within the larger

Adobe Consulting organization and with clients.

• Contribute to practice growth

o Capture and codify reusable assets (reference architectures, patterns, templates,

accelerators).

o Mentor other architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, and cloud architecture

best practices.

o Support pre-sales activities (e.g., solutioning, estimations, proposals, executive

presentations) to position Adobe and EA services.

o

What you need to succeed

• proven record to develop enterprise architecture models.

• Validated experience with architecture frameworks such as API, SOA, and TOGAF

• Understanding & experience with public cloud architecture and services (Microsoft

Azure / Amazon AWS).

• Experience designing or integrating AI-powered customer experiences, including

working with LLM-based services and understanding core concepts such as prompt

design, RAG, and model evaluation strategies.

• Ability to collaborate with data/ML teams to define AI solution patterns and

guardrails, including basic awareness of agentic workflows and tool using agents, and

how they impact reliability, observability, and governance in enterprise environments.

• Experience from working with the Adobe Experience Cloud or at least one of its

solutions & Previous experience with other Digital Marketing platforms. (Good to

have).

• Experience communicating across senior leadership.

• Ability to intake client business vision and translate to technical solution and

architecture requirements.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills communicating deliverables, sharing

information, and leading meetings.

• Ability to communicate and lead execution of architecture vision across multifunctional

technical and strategy teams.

• Experience working with software engineers, data architects, application developers &

data scientists to plan out end-to-end solutions

• Understanding the solutions and systems that support it.

• Ability to communicate technical and business strategy optimally to audiences of

varying levels of experience, background, and seniority.

• Ability to travel a minimum of up to 50%.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized

throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who

are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where

ongoing feedback flows freely.

If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees

are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful

benefits we offer.

Job Title: Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant – Finance

Role Summary

As an Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant, you will be the decisive authority on deal approvals within the EMEA region. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that customer proposals and contracts align with our strategic goals and financial principles. You will coordinate and manage the Enterprise C&P business, providing senior leadership with valuable insights and analysis on customer trends, deal structures, and product information. This is an outstanding opportunity to significantly influence Adobe's financial strategy while collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Review, Approval & Rejection

Serve as the primary EDS approver for EMEA Enterprise deals.

Review deal structures for compliance with pricing, discounting, margin, and booking policies.

Approve or reject deals based on strategic alignment and commercial viability.

Document decisions and provide clear rationale for approvals or rejections.

Advance deals that exceed authority thresholds with detailed recommendations.

Governance & Decision Quality

Enforce consistent application of approval policies across EMEA.

Ensure decisions protect long-term revenue integrity and customer value.

Balance sales objectives with risk management through effective decision-making.

Maintain comprehensive documentation for all deal approvals.

Deal Desk Team Partnership

Partner with the Deal Desk to deliver timely and accurate assessments on customer proposals

Ensure high-quality information, analysis, and documentation is maintained observing best practises.

Review and provide feedback to ensure decision quality for output.

Quarterly Deal Analysis & Executive Reporting

Provide and present quarterly insights on EMEA deal activity, including trends and risk analysis.

Leverage data and formulate actionable reports for leadership.

Identify and recommend adjustments to policies and pricing based on recurring issues.

Strategise go-to-market with future requirements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Communicate approval outcomes and rationale with Sales leadership.

Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on critical issues.

Ensure regional consistency in deal governance by aligning with global leadership.

Required Qualifications

Degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.

7–10+ years of background in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Finance.

Demonstrated experience in roles with deal approval responsibility.

Strong understanding of complex deal structures and EMEA commercial practices.

Preferred Experience

Experience working within global or matrixed organisations.

Knowledge of revenue recognition principles.

Proficiency with Dynamics and CPQ tools.

key Skills & Proficiencies

Decisive judgment and ability to challenge where necessary.

Strong financial competence and risk assessment skills.

Executive-level communication with data storytelling.

Attention to detail and a strong governance approach.

Ability to influence and initiate discussions.

Success Metrics

Uniformity and excellence in approval decisions.

Clear reasoning behind deal approval and rejection.

Reduction in policy deviations.

Punctuality and standard of Deal Desk deliverables.

Influence of quarterly deal insights.

Leadership confidence in EMEA deal governance.

Sales Leader, JAPAC – Digital Learning & Publishing

The Opportunity

At Adobe, we believe creativity changes the world. We empower people and organizations to imagine bigger, move faster, and deliver exceptional digital experiences—grounded in a culture of innovation, inclusion, and trust.

We are seeking a Sales Leader for JAPAC within Adobe Digital Advertising, Learning & Publishing (DALP). This role owns and scales Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) and AEM Guides, two strategic platforms at the core of Adobe’s enterprise learning and technical publishing portfolio.

Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) enables enterprises to upskill employees, partners, and customers through personalized, AI-powered learning and advanced analytics. AEM Guides is Adobe’s cloud-native CCMS for creating, managing, and publishing structured technical content at scale with speed and consistency.

This is a strategic leadership role with end-to-end responsibility for accelerating ALM and AEM Guides across JAPAC, driving enterprise learning and documentation transformation, and building future strategic account leadership within Adobe.

This role reports to the Director of Sales, APAC & EMEA

What You’ll Do

· Own the JAPAC number. Carry full responsibility for revenue, bookings, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy for ALM and AEM Guides

· Build a world-class sales organization. Hire, coach, and scale a high-performance JAPAC team with a strong succession bench

· Operate with precision. Instill disciplined pipeline rigor, CRM excellence, and MEDDICC-driven execution to deliver predictable outcomes

The opportunity

You have likely used something we built today, possibly more than once. Our distributed engineering team builds the next generation of Commerce capabilities for some of the biggest brands globally. In 2026, this involves systems where agents, models, and humans work together in the same loop. We deliver at a scale that was unattainable two years ago.

This isn't an AI-curious role. It's an AI-native one.

What you'll actually be doing

Own the integration between Adobe Commerce and LLM partners, the infrastructure that puts agentic shopping capabilities in front of millions of customers

Compose and build multi-agent workflows that decompose complex commerce problems: product discovery, personalization, checkout optimization, things that benefit from agents collaborating rather than a single monolithic service

Work across the stack on a high-performance, cloud-native e-commerce platform that's being actively reinvented

Build the architecture. We have hard problems and want engineers who want to get into them, not just complete tickets

Push back on how we've been doing things. If an agent can handle a chunk of work better, make the case and prove it

LLM API proficiency with Anthropic, OpenAI: streaming, function calling, structured outputs, and the judgment to manage cost/latency tradeoffs that matter at scale

Frontend: React

Backend: Python or Node.js, production-grade

Strong fundamentals: OOP, functional programming, source control, software lifecycle

APIs: RESTful, GraphQL

You own what you ship: CI/CD, monitoring and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus), infrastructure as code

· Research, train, and deploy SOTA ML models for enterprise use-cases
