· Build and optimize agentic AI workflows that enable users to dynamically interact and refine outputs from ML systems

· Develop scalable frameworks to evaluate the accuracy, robustness and usability of complex AI agents

· Partner closely with product, UX, business development and strategic partners to translate AI innovations into enterprise-grade production features

· Collaborate with AI Research team to constantly explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies and transform research ideas into interactive prototypes

· B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field

· 8+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production

· Proficiency in Python and deep knowledge of leading ML frameworks and libraries

· Strong passion for AI-driven innovation and a track record of delivering impactful, production-grade AI solutions

THE OPPORTUNITY

There are billions of Business Professionals and Consumers in the world who want to be both creative and efficient to accomplish their objectives. They see AI and conversational interfaces as a more productive way to accelerate creative storytelling and to quickly synthesize information across multiple documents. They are looking for quick and easy tools that are available on every computing surface and an easy onramp that allows them to trial products and subscribe based on the value derived. As the need for creative expression continues to grow exponentially, creativity and productivity are merging. AI can make them more creative and productive in their business context.

The job of the BP&C sales team is to bring this guiding message to our enterprise customers and to show how Adobe can provide value and compete against a new host of broad-based productivity products in the market.

BUSINESS GOALS

The opportunity described above will be the driving force of the Business Professionals and Consumers sales (BP&C) team. That team will be responsible for Adobe Acrobat and Adobe Express in the enterprise segment. Those products have increasing interconnected enterprise workflows that allow business professionals to understand and synthesise documents and other corporate material to produce highly designed and creative output via Express. This combination of insights and creativity lies at the center of what are customers are seeking and what the BP&C sales team is chartered to represent.

We are seeking an experienced First Line Manager to lead and scale our Business Professional & Consumer sales organization across the Western EMEA region ( Nordics- Benelux- France- Iberica – Italy). This leader will set regional standards, build strong operating rhythms, and partner cross-functionally to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale. This role plays a critical part in scaling Adobe’s growth across in the Business Professional segment by building strong Sales Specialists Team, consistent execution, and customer-centric sales motions. Success in this role requires both critical thinking and hands-on leadership in moments that matter most.

What You'll Do

Regional Pipeline & Growth Leadership for Business Professional segment

• Own and drive regional pipeline generation strategy across Western EMEA, ensuring consistent execution of a sales specialist team.

• Translate global growth strategies into market-specific pipeline and coverage plans aligned to regional business needs.

• Establish inspection cadences and performance expectations that drive predictable pipeline creation and sustained growth within the Business professional Sales Specialits team

• Partner closely with Sales Operations and Marketing to track, analyze, and improve pipeline health and conversion.

Deal Execution & Forecast Excellence

• Provide leadership oversight across deal cycles, ensuring quality discovery, strong value articulation, and effective progression to close.

• Ensure teams consistently address: Customer pain and urgency, Executive alignment, Clear reasons for Adobe solutions

• Engage directly in select strategic and high-impact deals to unblock progress and model standard processes. 

Manager Development & Coaching

• Lead, coach, and develop Sales Specialitsts, building their capability to: Run effective pipeline and deal reviews, Coach for skill development and behaviour change, Drive accountability and execution consistency.

• Set a clear bar for sales leadership excellence and foster a culture of continuous improvement across the region.

Executive & Line-of-Business Engagement

• Enable teams to effectively sell to C-level and senior line-of-business leaders across Sales, Marketing, IT, Finance, HR, and Legal.

• Support sellers in navigating complex collaborator environments and executive decision-making processes. 

• Represent the region credibly in senior internal and external engagements.

Portfolio & Ecosystem Leadership

• Promote strong understanding of customer technology environments and how Adobe solutions integrate into them.

• Strong track record of driving predictable pipeline and revenue growth in enterprise or B2B sales environments.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles.

• Strong executive presence, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience operating in EMEA or similarly diverse regions strongly preferred.

Role Description

The Technical Pre-Sales Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for closing strategic sales opportunities and enabling customer success through marketing technology value realization. For Adobe’s Top 50 customers, the EA partners with technology, promotional, and executive-level contacts. They assess current-state technology and business objectives. They deliver future-state marketing architectures, manage digital engagement roadmaps, and showcase “Art of the Possible” experiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Past experience in a lead consultative role supporting large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems as an Architect, Principal Consultant or Marketing/Technical leader.

Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing MarTech, such as CDPs, Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Journey Orchestration, Measurement and Optimization, Content Management, Content Generation, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Tag Management and Data Collection, Identity and Consent Management, CRM, Media Execution, Social Media Management, Reporting/Insights, and multi-channel activation.

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, value-focused narratives for technical, marketing, and executive audiences.

Skilled at diagnosing business and technical gaps and crafting forward-looking architectures aligned to strategic outcomes and measurable business value

Strong written and verbal communications skills with particular expertise in PowerPoint and Lucid Chart/Visio

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience

Skills that Set You Apart 

One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications in Adobe (RTCDP, AJO, Analytics/CJA, AEM, Target or Workfront)

Recent experience building enterprise level ROI-focused Business Cases for technology transformations

Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications

Deep understanding of B2B marketing strategies, buying journeys, and account-based engagement models.

Experience managing a Book of Business, including overseeing the ecosystem to drive deal closure, performing scope and contract reviews, and tracking value realization.

Experience with AI technologies and ability to support AI adoption in marketing use cases, accelerating onboarding to Adobe solutions and driving measurable customer success.

Proficiency with bringing to bear Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Principal Computer Scientist to serve as the technical leader and architect

for our next-generation SaaS application. This role is ideal for someone who has deep experience

in building and scaling customer-facing software and who can also guide the integration of

generative AI and ML technologies into real-world applications.

You’ll work with engineering, product, and research teams to define and implement architectural

strategies that support both robust application development and intelligent, AI-enhanced features.

You’ll be responsible for identifying and integrating the right generative AI or ML technologies

for the job, driving and measuring product improvements, understanding and managing

production systems, and improving engineering health.

Job Responsibilities

• Serve as a technical lead and architect, driving the design and implementation of scalable

SaaS applications with integrated AI/ML capabilities.

• Partner with engineering and product leaders to align platform architecture with business

goals and customer needs.

• Design and evolve application architecture for production readiness, including scalability,

reliability, and observability.

• Guide the selection and integration of generative AI and ML technologies (e.g., LLMs,

vector databases, fine-tuning frameworks) into application workflows.

• Collaborate with ML research teams to scope and implement fine-tuning or

reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF) strategies when needed.

• Provide technical mentorship and leadership across engineering teams.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 15+ years of experience in full-stack software development, with a strong focus on

customer-facing SaaS platforms.

• Proven success in designing and scaling distributed systems and cloud-native applications

• Strong understanding of architectural principles for production systems, scalability,

reliability and monitoring.

• Experience integrating generative AI/ML technologies into applications

• Experience with LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock)

• Understanding of vector search (ElasticSearch, MongoDB, Pinecone)

• Awareness of fine-tuning techniques (e.g., RLHF, LoRA, PEFT)

• Ability to scope and direct lightweight model customization

• Expert-level proficiency in modern web technologies and component libraries (Lit,

React)

• Deep backend engineering experience for highly-scaled, horizontally deployed

microservices (Python, NodeJS, Kubernetes)

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills to convey technical vision across teams

and leadership.

• Track record of multi-functional collaboration and technical leadership.

In this innovative role, you will be at the forefront of Adobe’s next generation experiences on web and in mobile apps. You will build an end-to-end understanding of the customer experience and then act on opportunities through in-quarter actions as well as multi-quarter roadmap planning. This role is highly cross functional and will collaborate across several organizations to ensure goal alignment and strong execution of strategic priorities that drive ARR and customer success. Critically, this role will play a foundational role in defining how future experiences are built in Japan for web, mobile web, and mobile apps. 

 

As an advocate for the customer, your mantra is to remove friction and challenge mental models in order to deliver significant improvements to the user experience. You will partner with Digital Growth & Ecommerce, A.com, Web & Mobile Product, User Research, Business Intelligence, and Marketing teams to implement with precision and approach and solve problems strategically. 

What you'll Do 

Lead the mobile app store business in Japan, using existing Adobe frameworks and creating new ones as needed. 

Lead recurring Mobile RTB (run-the-business) meetings to assess current performance and future outlook, shape strategic POVs, and drive aligned actions working with cross-functional teams that support growth and risk mitigation. 

Create and run a framework for optimizing mobile web journeys to the app stores or multi-surface, multi-journey-step mobile web experiences. 

Develop deep end-to-end understanding of Japan’s key user journeys across Mobile, Social, and Web products. Translate insights into prioritized, data-driven growth recommendations and clearly communicate them to leadership to drive alignment and execution. 

Diagnose the health of a product discovery, initial use, and engagement, from exploration through to activation and repeat use, to find opportunities and deliver value to customers on an ongoing basis. 

Influence key Product decisions on Mobile and Web through your understanding of market dynamics, competitive landscape, and performance data. 

Define, translate, and communicate results, including near and long-term business impact. 

What you need to succeed 

10+ years of commerce, software, management consulting, or business analytics experience. 

Strong experience in financial, business, and marketing analytics, including mobile and web, with a proven ability to synthesize data to generate clear and concise POVs and recommend actions. 

Experience creating and leading cross-functional teams across marketing, web, product management, product marketing, data analytics, and agency partners to execute initiatives that drive business impact. 

Experience or hands-on exposure across mobile growth disciplines—including user acquisition, engagement, and testing and optimization—is a plus. 

Ability to work independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, adapting quickly to change and shifting priorities. 

Business-level or expert proficiency in data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Branch, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Power BI); familiarity with web and mobile engagement solutions is a plus. 

Business-level Japanese and advanced English proficiency required for effective communication with global peers and stakeholders. 

MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

The Project Graph team is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our Graph platform, a core, highly technical product used to design, visualize, execute, and share complex workflows through graph-based systems. Project Graph powers both an advanced node-based editor and downstream, simplified experiences built on top of those graphs.

This role sits at the intersection of UX, systems design, AI-enabled workflows, and platform thinking, and requires deep empathy for advanced users such as developers, technical artists, ML practitioners, and designers.

As a principal-level PM, you will define long-term direction, tackle ambiguous problems, and work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to scale a powerful, performant, and extensible graph authoring and execution platform.

What you’ll do

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Graph platform, including the editor, execution model, plugins, APIs, extensibility, and interoperability across products and surfaces.

Define what “great” looks like for graph-based authoring across beginner, advanced, and expert users, including transitions between power-user tooling and simplified downstream experiences.

Lead discovery efforts to deeply understand user workflows, pain points, and mental models in graph-based and automation-driven systems.

Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements, PRDs, and success metrics across both authoring and execution.

Collaborate with design to shape interaction patterns for node creation, connections, layouts, debugging, inspection, and working at scale.

Partner closely with engineering to break down large, ambiguous problems into shippable increments without losing architectural coherence.

Work with engineers on architecture-level decisions affecting performance, data models, rendering, and execution to ensure the system performs well with large graphs and real-world workloads.

Understand and influence systems such as graph execution models, state management, serialization, versioning, and reproducibility.

Define platform primitives that enable reuse, sharing, and distribution of graph-based workflows in different contexts.

Act as a bridge between user needs and technical realities, setting clear outcomes while avoiding prescriptive implementation decisions.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of complex, technical, or platform products.

Prior experience with node-based editors, visual programming tools, workflow builders, automation systems, or graph-based products, direct or adjacent.

Proven track record of shipping and iterating on sophisticated user interfaces used by expert or technical users.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to reason about interconnected components, constraints, and emergent behavior.

Deep empathy for power users and creators who rely on precision, speed, debuggability, and flexibility.

Comfort working closely with highly technical engineering teams on performance-critical, architecture-heavy systems.

Ability to operate independently at a principal level while influencing cross-functional partners.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for complex and abstract concepts.

Bonus points

Background in developer tools, creative tools, game engines, VFX pipelines, ML tooling, data platforms, or automation systems.

Familiarity with graph concepts such as DAGs, execution graphs, dependency graphs, and scheduling.

Experience with extensible platforms, plugin systems, SDKs, or scripting environments.

Experience shipping products that combine authoring tools with runtime or execution environments.

Exposure to AI-driven workflows, generative systems, or model orchestration tools.

The Opportunity
The Technical Consultant designs and delivers end-to-end digital experience and commerce solutions using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Adobe Commerce. Acting as a technology advisor, this role guides clients in architectural decisions, platform integrations, and implementation strategies for measurable business impact. The architect leads solution design throughout discovery, development, deployment, and optimization phases, collaborating with business consultants, project managers, and engineering teams to ensure alignment with client objectives and Adobe best practices.

Focusing on content and commerce, the Technical Consultant unifies content management and commerce across channels, defines integration patterns, and leads technical frameworks to deliver seamless omnichannel experiences. The role also supports sales teams with solution estimation and prioritisation, requiring deep technical expertise, leadership, and cross-team collaboration.

Responsibilites:

Develop and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications using modern front-end technologies on Adobe Experience Manager.

Build reusable UI components and implement designs from wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.

Integrate front-end components with backend APIs.

Collaborate with UX/UI designers, backend developers, and content authors to deliver seamless digital experiences.

Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness across devices.

Optimize web applications for performance, scalability, and SEO best practices.

Implement accessibility standards (WCAG) and follow modern web development best practices.

Support content teams by enabling efficient content authoring within CMS/WCM platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve UI/UX issues and performance bottlenecks.

Participate in code reviews and maintain high code quality standards.

Efficiently multi-task, working across multiple client engagements at the same time as well as key internal initiatives.

Deliver high quality consulting services to our growing client base and lead ambassadorship in our client relationships.

Effectively analyze complex project issues, identify the possible solution options, and facilitate the presentation and review of the options and our recommended solution with the client.

Requirements:

2-5 years’ experience in the Web and/or ECMS technologies

2+ years of direct client consulting experience

Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as customer relationship building skills.

Articulate technical solutions and how they can solve client business problems to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Conceptually understand business requirements and translate them into architecture, design and development activities for our most complex and large Web based solutions.

Strong experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.

Proficiency with modern frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue.js, node.js or others.

Familiarity working with Web Content Management (WCM) platforms such as:

Adobe Experience Manager/Edge Delivery Services

Sitecore

Drupal

WordPress

Experience integrating CMS content with front-end components and APIs.

Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.

Familiarity with front-end frameworks that support design systems (Storybook, Bootstrap, Material UI) 

Expertise in Atomic design methodology 

Expertise in Design systems, Style guides, Pattern libraries 

Strong understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and web performance optimization.

Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and headless CMS architectures.

Experience with Git-based version control systems.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Experience with SEO best practices and analytics integration.

Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG).

Administration and debugging of Web servers, e.g. Apache.

Optimizing web solutions and architecting to accommodate performance requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent number years of experience

Position may require up to 30% travel

About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Transformation Program Manager to lead multi‑team, cross‑functional initiatives that advance Adobe’s strategic priorities. Key Responsibilities

Own scoped transformation workstreams within an enterprise program—plan, sequence, and track milestones; manage interdependencies; surface risks with clear mitigation proposals.

Establish and run governance rituals (standups, Scrum of Scrums, sprint reviews, release readiness, risk/issue reviews) and maintain high‑quality artifacts (RAIDs, roadmaps, dashboards).

Drive change & adoption by partnering with change managers and business owners to land new workflows, tools, and operating models; measure adoption and value realization.

Stakeholder & executive communication—synthesize progress, decisions, and risks into crisp updates for leadership; influence without authority across org boundaries.

Data‑driven execution—use program KPIs/OKRs, quality gates, and analytics to guide course corrections and continuous improvement.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement
Leverage perfo Familiarity with enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Adobe Cloud) and digital transformation programs.

Performance metrics and analytics to monitor progress, measure outcomes, and inform continuous improvement across programs.

Risk Management & Mitigation
Proactively identify risks and interdependencies, develop mitigation plans, and engage stakeholders to resolve issues before they impact delivery.

Innovation & Emerging Technology
Stay current on emerging digital trends, tools, and AI-enabled productivity solutions. Pilot new approaches that enhance efficiency, collaboration, and scalability.

Executive Alignment & Sustainability
Build alignment, gain executive sponsorship, and ensure sustainability of transformation efforts beyond program completion.

Qualifications

4-6 of experience in program management, enterprise transformation, or technical leadership within software industries

Proven experience leading cross‑functional programs/projects with measurable outcomes in tech or adjacent domains.

Demonstrated proficiency with Agile/Hybrid methods (Scrum, SAFe, Lean) and program governance.

Strong communication and influencing without authority across multiple stakeholder groups.

Familiarity with enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Adobe Cloud) and digital transformation programs.

Tools: Workfront, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Power BI (or equivalents).

Skilled in transformation governance and playbook implementation; applies and refines program standards and best practices.

Leads cutover planning, release management, and testing readiness to ensure smooth program transitions.

Job Description

Adobe Services Delivery is building deep and impactful partnerships with customers by investing our best thinking and resources to offer prescriptive, differentiated tools and thought leadership that help customers navigate and accelerate their digital trajectories.

Digital Strategists own the development and delivery of original, inspiring, and thought provoking workshops and strategic engagements that help customers chart their digital transformation journeys and feel confident taking the next steps—particularly in large scale, enterprise digital marketing environments leveraging Adobe Experience Cloud.

Workshop & Thought Leadership Development

Accountable for the development of workshops that foster cross functional partnerships and create practical roadmaps to help customers mature and transform their digital capabilities. Workshop materials include original assets designed to spark customer imagination and drive action on the vision established during the engagement. Deliverables may include POVs, strategy tools and methodologies, maturity models, and repeatable, hypothesis driven frameworks.

Expand existing repeatable, industry specific workshops into new industries, including associated data harvesting, analysis, collateral creation, and deliverable production.

Harvest insights from workshops to understand evolving customer needs and ensure offerings and prescriptive frameworks remain compelling, relevant, and up to date.

Author original thought leadership and compelling proposals on emerging or relevant digital themes to attract customers and drive new opportunities. Thought leadership may include proposals, frameworks, white papers, blogs, videos, and other media to support brand awareness, workshop adoption, and new business development.

Workshop & Thought Leadership Execution

Spearhead and own the delivery of high quality, consultative workshops with strong executive presence.

Engage C suite and senior executive audiences through compelling storytelling that drives action and organizational change.

Lead customers to strategic solutions that address complex business challenges using prescriptive methodologies, tools, frameworks, and high quality roadmaps.

Apply a cross discipline, entrepreneurial perspective, seamlessly adapting across topics and conversations to guide customers toward actionable outcomes.

Surface and drive new opportunities for Adobe Strategy and Readiness Services offerings.

Operations Management & Marketing

Track and monitor workshop and solution progress throughout the delivery lifecycle—from initial POVs to workshop execution, asset development, and final readouts.

Harvest and track insights and attributable operational outcomes to support reporting and growth.

Assist in the production of weekly customer impact newsletters.

Engage ecosystem stakeholders to promote workshops internally and externally, building a sustainable pipeline of customer participation.

What You Need to Succeed

Past experience in a consultative strategy role, leading or supporting large scale enterprise digital marketing transformations using Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration Cloud.

2+ years of experience delivering strategy and implementation services involving three or more of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solutions:

Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics

Adobe Journey Optimizer or Adobe Campaign

Adobe Real Time CDP or Audience Manager

Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Adobe Target

Adobe Experience Platform

GenStudio

Proven experience acting as a trusted advisor driving digital transformation initiatives.

Experience crafting digital or marketing strategies, with a strong understanding of the technologies and operating models required to activate them.

Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage both senior business leaders and technical stakeholders.

A forward thinking, self starting, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to create organic demand.

Creative problem solver capable of translating complex, ambiguous challenges into clear, navigable frameworks.

Strong business acumen with the ability to articulate value drivers through storytelling and recognize conversational cues to deepen engagement.

Awareness of fundamental negotiation techniques and the ability to apply them effectively.

Comfort navigating rapidly changing meeting dynamics and shifting priorities.

Outstanding analytical and problem solving skills, including research, data analysis, hypothesis development, and synthesis of recommendations.

Ability to identify patterns within complex and unstructured data sets to surface meaningful insights and opportunities.

High intellectual curiosity and ability to quickly absorb and apply new concepts.

Strong organizational and self marketing skills.

Big 4 or management consulting background preferred, but not required.

8–12 years of experience in UX strategy, digital strategy, customer experience, or management consulting.

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We’re passionate about empowering people to build breathtaking and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

Opportunity 

Security is foundational to Adobe’s product development and operational excellence. Our security practices are deeply embedded across our software lifecycle and are continuously refined through collaboration with global partners, leading researchers, and industry organizations. These efforts ensure Adobe remains at the forefront of threat detection, prevention, and incident response.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Security India to lead and expand Adobe’s global security engineering capabilities, with a strong focus on our India operations. This executive will play a critical role in shaping Adobe’s security strategy, driving innovation, and building trust with our customers by ensuring their data is protected and privacy is preserved.

Role Summary 

As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. You will collaborate closely with the CSO, global engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to shape and drive enterprise-wide security initiatives, in addition to engaging externally with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customers. This role requires a visionary leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a proven track record of influencing at the executive level.

What You’ll Do 

Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the long-term vision for Adobe’s security engineering function in India, aligned with global security priorities.

Site Presence: Continue to build the security brand and presence in India with leaders across Adobe.

Customer-Facing: Engage with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customer to help build trust in our products, build relationships and help answer their security related questions, and in case of a security incident, quickly come up to speed to lead customer confidence calls.

Global Collaboration: Partner with the CSO and senior leaders across engineering, legal, and cloud infrastructure to drive cohesive security strategies.

Operational Excellence: Oversee delivery of high-impact security services, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Innovation & Engineering: Lead teams in developing innovative solutions for application security, cloud security, and cyber defense.

Risk Management: Champion enterprise risk mitigation strategies, including threat modeling, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Talent Development: Build and mentor a high-performing team of security engineers, researchers, and ethical hackers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and inclusion.

Stakeholder Engagement: Establish trust and influence with senior executives, internal partners, and external vendors to advance Adobe’s security posture.

Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to global security standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

Thought Leadership: Represent Adobe in industry forums, contribute to security research, and drive awareness of emerging threats and standard processes.

Complexity: Navigate a highly matrixed organization, building on strong partnerships across regions to shape security strategy, execution, and long-term Adobe success and reputation.

What You Need to Succeed 

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Security Engineering, or related field.

15+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, including 10+ years in leadership roles with global scope.

Proven success leading large-scale security programs across cloud, application, and enterprise environments.

Deep expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, and secure software development practices.

Strong understanding of infrastructure as code, security automation, and compliance as code.

Experience managing cross-functional teams, building strong partnerships across regions, influencing senior partners, and building customer relationships.

Recognized as an influential, innovative, and collaborative leader in the industry.

Certifications such as CISM, CISA, or CISSP are a plus.

Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and executive presence, both internally and externally.

Demonstrated commitment to inclusive practices.

The Opportunity 

The Senior Manager, Business Intelligence, Content is a strategic leader responsible for driving predictive insight for content optimization across multiple business units. This role shapes a multi-year intelligence strategy that improves content utilization, marketplace liquidity, and readiness for emerging customer and AI model-training needs.

You will transform analytics into scalable, automated intelligence that informs content acquisition, monetization pathways, contributor performance, and portfolio-level investment. Partnering cross-functionally with product, engineering, finance, and content operations, you will translate complex data into actionable recommendations that influence prioritization and business model evolution.

This leader will also build and develop a high-performing analytics team, elevate organizational intelligence maturity, and accelerate real-time, data-driven decision support at scale.

What You’ll Do

Own and evolve a portfolio-level intelligence framework that measures content value, utilization, and performance across multiple businesses, informing planning and investment.

Assess content supply health across depth, fragmentation, contributor and geographic diversity, metadata, and coverage to drive sourcing priorities and readiness for emerging customer needs.

Identify and prioritize strategic content gaps by analyzing search behavior, market signals, enterprise requirements, and generative prompt patterns, shaping acquisition and production roadmaps.

Lead advanced analytics initiatives to optimize supply-side economics, including ranking efficacy, contributor yield, marketplace liquidity, and monetization pathways.

Develop predictive and forecasting models that anticipate shifts in demand, creative trends, AI training requirements, and revenue contribution, guiding multi-year content strategies.

Lead all aspects of building visualization dashboards, important metrics, and reporting frameworks that surface sourcing efficiency, contributor performance, and content economic value.

Partner cross-functionally across product, engineering, content, finance, and enterprise teams to operationalize insights, evolve business models, and accelerate real-time predictive decisions.

Lead, develop, and mentor a hard-working analytics team, strengthening talent capabilities, driving analytical rigor, and maturing organizational intelligence practices at scale.

What You Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Science within digital media, marketplaces, or eCommerce environments.

Strong analytical and statistical skills with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems into measurable frameworks.

Proficiency in SQL (or Hive), Python or R, ETL development, and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks).

Proven experience building and operationalizing predictive models, forecasting systems, and segmentation frameworks.

Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks) and advanced statistical modeling, and designing executive-ready dashboards using Tableau or equivalent.

Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership through clear data storytelling and strategic recommendations.

Experience leading data-informed transformation and multi-year, cross-business initiatives using emerging AI/ML capabilities.

The Opportunity
The Adobe Security Engineering Partnerships (SEP) team is seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to scale security capabilities across our software Supply Chain, Kubernetes deployment environments, and cloud-native systems.
We're looking for a candidate that is passionate about securing the software
development lifecycle (SDLC), strengthening software supply chain integrity, and
embedding security into modern delivery pipelines using automation-first, secure-by-default approaches. You will operate as a security expert, influencing engineering organizations and key stakeholders, designing scalable security solutions, and independently managing risk across complex, cloud-native systems.

What you'll Do 

Develop and implement security controls across CI/CD platforms including GitHub workflows, Jenkins, and internal build systems.

Establish secure-by-default pipeline standards covering build isolation, artifact integrity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

Identify systemic supply chain risks and build scalable mitigations that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities.

Secure Kubernetes-based platforms across multi-cloud environments.

Define security baselines for clusters, workloads, container runtimes, admission controls, and network segmentation.

Perform security architecture reviews for complex CI/CD, cloud, and Kubernetes environments.

Independently manage security risk by making defensible, risk-based decisions balancing business velocity and security posture.

Recognize capability gaps and design new security solutions that increase coverage and effectiveness across multiple product areas.

Serve as a trusted security advisor and technical lead within your domain.

Establish yourself as a domain expert in CI/CD, supply chain, and cloud security.

What you need to succeed 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field of study.

6+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, or a related field.

Experience threat modeling for CI/CD and cloud-native systems.

Deep expertise in CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Strong experience securing Kubernetes and containerized workloads in cloud-native environments.

Hands-on knowledge of software supply chain security, artifact signing, and open-source risk management.

Experience implementing GitOps workflows and securing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

Strong programming or scripting ability (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) with experience building automation and security tooling.

Demonstrated ability to identify systemic risks and design scalable, automation-first mitigations.

Strong understanding of Secure SDLC practices and how security solutions reduce risk across large organizations.

Proven ability to influence engineering teams and serve as a technical leader without formal management authority.

Architect and evolve large-scale front-end systems using modern web technologies, with a focus on React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

Expert-level knowledge of React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Hands-on experience designing systems using micro-frontends, shared UI platforms, and design systems.

The Opportunity

As a Value Engineer within the JAPAC Ultimate Success team, you will partner closely with Value Advisors and Account Teams to build rigorous, defensible financial models that quantify the measurable business impact of Adobe’s solutions.

Your mandate is to ensure that every value claim — from revenue uplift to retention improvement and operational efficiency — is supported by structured assumptions, credible benchmarks, and CFO-ready modelling. You will operate at the intersection of finance, analytics, and strategy, translating complex product capabilities and customer data into clear economic impact models that withstand executive scrutiny.

This role is less about leading the room and more about ensuring that when we enter it, our numbers are airtight.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modelling & Quantification

Build robust return on investment, NPV, payback, and scenario-based financial models to quantify revenue growth, retention impact, cost efficiencies, and productivity gains.

Conduct sensitivity analysis and assumption testing to ensure models remain defensible under CFO-level scrutiny.

Structure value levers clearly and prevent double-counting across impact areas.

Translate marketing, commerce, and experience metrics into financial outcomes (margin impact, lifetime value, cost avoidance).

Develop scalable modelling templates and tools to standardise value calculations across the region.

Value Workshops and Business Case Development

Partner with Value Advisors and Account Teams to convert strategic value hypotheses into quantified economic impact to support Value Workshops and Business case development.

Document assumptions transparently and apply conservative modelling principles to maintain credibility.

Reconcile customer-supplied data with benchmarks and Adobe telemetry to ensure integrity of outputs.

Support renewals and expansion cases with defensible financial analysis.

Prepare executive-ready financial summaries that simplify complex modelling into clear decision-support outputs. 

Be able to explain, communicate and answer questions on the business case or models to customer executives.

Value Realisation Analytics

Track realised versus projected value across use cases, adoption, and Net Dollar Retention (N$R).

Analyse performance data to identify value at risk, underperformance drivers, and incremental growth opportunities.

Support quarterly business reviews with updated financial insights and scenario updates.

Maintain structured measurement frameworks to ensure consistent value tracking across strategic accounts.

Benchmarking & Methodology

Understand and leverage existing Adobe tools to support Value modelling,

Maintain and refine regional industry benchmarks and modelling assumptions.

Incorporate new Adobe product capabilities into financial impact models.

Contribute to the evolution of JAPAC value modelling frameworks, templates, and playbooks.

Support automation and AI-enabled modelling to scale analytical output while maintaining rigor.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate closely with Value Advisors, Sales, Ultimate Success teams, and Professional Services to ensure alignment between strategy and quantification.

Act as the quantitative authority during value workshops, renewal planning and expansion conversations.

Provide internal coaching on modelling rigor and financial logic.

Help embed value thinking into lifecycle planning and expansion strategies.

What you bring:

5–10+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Deals Advisory, Valuations, Strategy Consulting, Corporate Development, or Value Engineering.

Advanced financial modelling capability (expert Excel skills required; experience with scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis essential).

Strong understanding of SaaS economics, marketing return on investment, retention modelling, and unit economics.

Proven experience building defensible arguments for enterprise technology or digital transformation programs.

High analytical rigor and comfort challenging assumptions.

Ability to translate complex financial analysis into crisp, executive-ready outputs.

Experience supporting executive-level discussions (not necessarily leading them).

Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud (Customer Experience Orchestration) or similar Martech ecosystems preferred.

Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (especially advanced Excel).

Currently enrolled in a General Assembly Immersive through Adobe’s Digital Academy program

Excellent communication skills; able to convey complex ideas visually and verbally.

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

What you'll Do 

RAG System Design

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

What you need to succeed 

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong ML and Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer/Architect to lead the development of next-generation personalization models and intelligent AI agents within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
Our team is building intelligent agent systems that can autonomously design, generate, optimize, and evaluate personalization models at scale. These agents reason over customer data, business objectives, and experimentation signals to create adaptive models that continuously improve digital experiences.
As a senior member of the AI team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of personalization AI systems, from research and modeling to production deployment, monitoring, and MLOps automation. You will work at the intersection of personalization modeling, multimodal LLMs, agentic reasoning, real-time decisioning, and enterprise-scale ML infrastructure.
This role is ideal for engineers and applied scientists who want to build production-grade AI systems that autonomously power personalization, targeting, ranking, and next-best-action strategies across billions of interactions.
You’ll collaborate closely with Adobe Research, Product Management, and Platform Engineering to ensure AI-driven personalization is not an add-on—but a foundational capability embedded across Adobe’s Customer Experience Orchestration products.

What You’ll Do

Design and build advanced personalization models including propensity models, recommendation models and systems, uplift models, reinforcement learning, and generative personalization systems.

Develop LLM-powered intelligent agents that can generate and tune personalization models, automate experimentation and model optimization and recommend next-best-actions and targeting strategies

Architect and implement end-to-end ML systems, including:

Feature engineering pipelines (batch and streaming)

Model training and evaluation frameworks

Low-latency inference systems

Build and scale real-time decisioning systems that operate across high-throughput enterprise environments.

Lead MLOps initiatives, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, automated retraining, and performance governance.

Drive system reliability, scalability, and observability across distributed ML services.

Partner with product leaders to translate personalization strategy into measurable business impact.

Mentor engineers on modern ML practices, agentic AI design, and production grade ML architecture.

Champion responsible AI and personalization practices, focusing on interpretability, fairness, safety, and user trust.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience, or PhD with 5+ years building and deploying ML systems at scale.

Deep expertise in personalization systems, recommendation models, or real-time decisioning architectures.

Some experience with LLMs, agentic systems, prompt engineering, RAG, or context engineering, especially in production environments.

Proven success building and shipping end-to-end ML systems, from research to deployment and ongoing optimization.

Hands-on experience with MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, monitoring, automated retraining, CI/CD for ML, and large-scale inference systems.

Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain, or equivalent.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect modeling decisions to business metrics such as lift, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

Experience bridging research and production in enterprise scale AI applications.

The Challenge

Adobe is looking for an exceptional Developer focused on platform engineering, automation, and engineering intelligence to join an engineering productivity team. In this role, you will build and improve systems developed to scale and support engineering workflows. You will also handle telemetry integration, automation, and visibility across client, online, and handheld device platforms.

You will help architect resilient services that integrate CI/CD, automation, developer, and operational signals into scalable systems that deliver reliable and actionable insights. Building software at Adobe’s scale requires platforms that are fast, dependable, secure, and designed to support engineers effectively.

If you enjoy solving complex problems and building systems that improve how large engineering teams build, measure, and operate software, this role is for you.

What you’ll do

Develop and maintain scalable backend services and automation frameworks that support Desktop, Web, and Mobile environments.

Design and evolve infrastructure that powers engineering workflows, operational visibility, and system insights.

Build modern web interfaces and dashboards that translate complex telemetry into clear, actionable insights.

Drive end-to-end automation to streamline workflows and provide reliable access to build, quality, system, and engineering health signals.

Partner with product and engineering teams to improve developer experience, engineering confidence, and data-driven decision making.

Apply data analysis and AI or ML techniques to extract insights from engineering telemetry and improve automation.

Evaluate and enforce application, operating system, and security requirements across automation and infrastructure systems.

Maintain version control and infrastructure-as-code practices that ensure reproducibility, scalability, and reliability.

What you need to succeed

Experience defining engineering metrics and building dashboards or reporting systems that surface operational and quality insights.

2–3 years of hands-on experience with languages such as Python, JavaScript, or similar backend technologies with strong service development experience.

Experience building modern web applications and visualization layers using contemporary frontend frameworks and web technologies.

Production experience with containerization and orchestration solutions, for example Docker and Kubernetes.

Experience building and operating services including

CI and CD integrations

Monitoring and alerting platforms such as Splunk, Prometheus, and New Relic

Kubernetes-based deployments

Infrastructure as code and provisioning tools such as Terraform, SaltStack, or similar

Data ingestion, processing, and analytics pipelines

Experience designing APIs and backend services that consume, transform, and expose engineering workflow data.

Exposure to AI, ML, or intelligent systems used to analyze operational data and generate insights.

Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to evolving problem spaces.

Ability to write and maintain high-quality, well-tested code.

Strong debugging skills across distributed systems and the ability to deliver sustainable architectural solutions.

Experience working with large and globally distributed engineering teams where automation, visibility, and data-driven insights are critical.

Ability to clearly document system architecture, operational workflows, and APIs.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

A practical systems-thinking attitude and comfort operating in complex platform environments.

The Opportunity

The Global Integrated Marketing team drives Adobe’s enterprise B2B marketing strategy by crafting cohesive, cross-channel campaigns that connect with audiences worldwide and ensure every touchpoint reflects business objectives, on-brand messaging, and customer needs.

We’re seeking a Principal to lead a set of global B2B marketing campaigns and own the end-to-end strategy—from planning and orchestration to performance analysis! This role will partner closely across the marketing ecosystem on execution, messaging, and content development to drive measurable results. Do you enjoy working cross-functionally and seeing your campaign vision come to life? We'd love for you to join our team.

Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy: Lead the development of marketing strategies that span regions and channels and align marketing goals with overall business objectives and target audience needs.

Channel coordination and consistency: Streamline efforts across cross-functional teams to implement campaigns effectively and ensure a unified strategy across marketing channels.

Market & customer knowledge: Stay on top of innovation and industry trends, competitive landscape, marketing capabilities, customer behavior, and new technologies to inform campaign strategy. Have an in-depth knowledge of common business challenges our customers face and how Adobe products help solve those challenges.

Reporting and optimization: Monitor and report on marketing campaigns, using metrics to assess performance and optimizations needed. Develop and communicate insights, optimizations, and/or pivots needed through run-the-business and quarterly business reviews.

Cross-functional influence & accountability: Extensively collaborate and influence key team members, working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Digital and Events centers of excellence, BDRs, and senior leadership. Communicate effectively at various levels regarding marketing objectives and outcomes.

Deliverables and Outcomes

Development and communication of end-to-end campaigns planned and in market

Facilitate a degree of coordination across centers-of-excellence and for the execution of campaigns across channel, content, and related teams

Ensure consistent messaging and alignment across all channels

End-to-end campaign performance analysis and insights, including finding opportunities for optimization that elevate the impact of our B2B marketing

What’s Needed to Succeed:

Significant experience in B2B marketing planning, including managing a range of marketing programs and tactics.

Proven ability to design and implement global, multi-channel campaigns that align with business priorities and drive measurable outcomes.

Strong background in analysis and performance optimization, including reporting and insights to inform pivots and improve return on investment.

Outstanding communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.

Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments—anticipating challenges and proactively solving them.

Skilled at influencing and steering large-scale initiatives without direct authority, with a positive attitude that encourages collaboration and momentum!

Clear, informed perspective on what 'good' looks like across all facets of campaign marketing.

The Opportunity
 

The Digital Strategy Group works with C-level leadership at Adobe’s Enterprise customers to advise on strategies for customer-experience transformation and digital innovation. Our engagements employ Adobe’s digital benchmarking capabilities, industry trends, customer-journey mapping, organizational assessments and other techniques to deliver high-impact recommendations. Today, Adobe is at the forefront of enabling our customers’ digital transformation and new experience-led business models.

With governments in the region adapting to increasing citizen expectations, we require a Digital Strategy Principal based in Singapore, to lead and work on DSG Strategic Engagements. This role with work with the DSG Industry Practice leads across APAC (especially FSI, Retail, Travel, and Media), providing them senior leadership and executive presence in market!

What you'll do:

As a Digital Strategy Principal, you will both support the analysis for and lead strategy engagements with current and prospective Adobe customers on the biggest deals in APAC. You will be a Strategic Adviser who brings real-world digital transformation knowledge to customers across sectors to drive business growth, optimize customer experience, amplify brand awareness, lower costs and improve productivity.
 

For each engagement, you will quarterback a team of experts (in areas such as digital marketing, customer-experience design, digital analytics and Value modelling) to conduct analyses and interviews, develop insights, identify use cases, model commercial value and deliver your findings and recommendations – outlining the value potential enabled by Adobe solutions/technologies by industry.

You will represent Adode as a industry leader on trends, digital innovation, use cases, build cases for investment, and relevant research and thought leadership in your industry.

You will enable the field on key Industry POVs and how to have value led conversations also.

In addition to 1:1 DSG Engagements, you will also be involved in :

Building and nurturing pipe

Running Exec connects with C suite Industry executives

Working with Marketing to scale thought leadership an extend our reach

Presenting at external events and Adobe’s biggest conferences (e.g. Experience Makers)

Adobe’s vision for industry and aligning GTM & solutions

White space modelling to identify new sales opportunities

Enablement with the field (Sales, Renewals, SCs, Partner team, Product Marketing) and with our Partners

Work with field sales teams to understand and expand revenue opportunities

Collaborate with sales and marketing to identify, accelerate and close sales pipeline

Facilitate 1:1 or 1:Many customer visioning workshops (Design Thinking or Strategic)

Contribute to practice development through thought leadership content, business benchmarking and assessments against leading practice

Represent Adobe externally and internally on industry sector, innovation and value management related topics

You will work with an experienced and motivated team, including alumni from top consulting firms and leading Digital organizations.
 

What you need to succeed:

MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Relevant experience in either the Marketing function within a leading company or A top-tier management consulting organization or A top-tier digital agency

Expertise in or working with Government 

Experience in creating digital strategies along with a high-level understanding of the technologies and tactics needed for execution

Strong executive presence and communication skills, with ability to engage, advise and inspire senior executives

Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills including talent for conducting research

Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively verbally and in writing – and a strong presenter

High degree of intellectual curiosity and ability to absorb concepts quickly

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in Germany.

As a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services, you will guide architecture through the transformation lifecycle. You will build executive confidence, govern design decisions, lead architecture build, and make sure technology choices support long-term value.

What you’ll do

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

Fluency in English and German is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

Adobe’s Enterprise Marketing GTM Team is at the forefront of reimagining the end-to-end GTM process, from strategy to execution, using generative and agentic AI. We are looking for an experienced Principal Go-to-Market Innovation Manager for a high-visibility role with exposure to senior leadership and opportunities to shape how Adobe delivers experiences to enterprise customers. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in marketing, data analytics, decision sciences, or strategy/management consulting, and a passion for driving business impact.

What You’ll Do

Develop AI-Driven Marketing Capabilities: Collaborate on initiatives to develop agentic capabilities for Adobe’s GTM practitioners. Scope use cases and translate data into actionable insights and next-best-action recommendations. Support Proof-of-Concept testing to improve agentic capabilities and recommendations

Foster Integrated GTM Strategy & Alignment: Drive strategic alignment and cohesion between Marketing, BDR and Sales, including rigorous definition and distribution of key value props, target segments, accounts and personas, and areas of highest revenue potential

Data Driven Problem-Solving: Use analytics to build efficiency and effectiveness into our marketing model. Create advanced marketing measurement capabilities. Build predictive models to optimize ROI, spend, and targeting

Translate Account, Persona, & Content Strategy and Actionable Insights: Use data to devise metrics, solve problems and influence executive decision-making. Contribute to the creation and evolution of marketing scorecards and dashboards.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead cross-functional workstreams with stakeholders across Enterprise Marketing, PMM, Sales, Content Strategy, ACS, and CXO Products to drive alignment and execution. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

8 - 10+ years of experience including experience in B2B marketing, GTM strategy, or marketing operations, preferably in enterprise SaaS or tech

Excellent communication and storytelling skills

The Cross Practices organization serves as the strategic backbone of Americas Services Delivery. Role Summary: 

The Professional Development Enablement Creator will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and focuses on designing, developing, and curating educational content, training materials, and resources to improve employee performance and professional growth. This role typically acts as a bridge between subject matter experts (SMEs) and the workforce, turning complex information into engaging, actionable, and scalable learning experiences, often using tools like Learning Management Systems (LMS), video, and interactive modules. The Professional Development Enablement Creator must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, understanding program management and an eye for user experience. 

What You’ll Do: 

Content Creation & Development: Design, write, and produce training materials, including e-learning modules, videos, job aids, playbooks, and self-service resources. 

Strategy Execution: Collaborate with business leaders, SMEs and individual contributors to execute leadership vision & strategy and create role-specific learning paths. 

Content Management & Design: Owning the content management for enablement resources and design for easy navigation for end user. 

Curriculum & Asset Management: Maintain a centralized repository of training materials (LMS), ensuring content is accurate, up-to-date, and easily searchable. 

Impact Analysis: Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of training initiatives through data, analytics, and feedback to ensure continuous improvement. 

Onboarding & Development: Develop and maintain structured onboarding programs to accelerate time-to-productivity for new hires. 
 

What You’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor's degree required in Change Management, Organizational Design, Communications, Marketing, Education, or similar field. 

5+ years of proven experience in video editing or content creation, particularly in a corporate or educational setting and preferably in a SaaS or technology company. 

Proficiency in e-learning software, learning management systems and video creation tools. 

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in diverse content creation, editing styles and, ideally, education content. 

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain continuity, pacing, and visual storytelling standards. 

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment. 

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. 

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred. 

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration product suite is a plus. 

 

Performance Measurement: 

This role will be measured against a predefined Business-Driven Objective (BDO) that aligns with Adobe Consulting’s strategic goals. The BDO will focus on: 

Increased Time to Value 

Consistent usage of Role-based operating rhythms, included delivery role definitions and rationalization 

Increased automations in delivery processes 

Increased asset reusability 

Defined framework for cross training strategy 

 

Progress toward the BDO will be reviewed quarterly and used to guide performance feedback, team alignment, and strategic prioritization.

Senior Data Engineer & Architect

Location: San Jose, CA

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Senior Manager, Data & Analytics Platform Engineering

About the Role

The Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Product Success Engineering team is hiring a Senior Data Engineer & Architect to help build and scale the infrastructure that powers product adoption insights, customer retention analytics, system performance monitoring, and operational intelligence across Adobe.

In this role, you will design and build reliable, scalable, cloud-native data systems while contributing to platform-wide architectural direction and standards. You’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Solution Architects, and Product partners to translate evolving business needs into durable data solutions that support analytics and machine learning use cases.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on engineering while influencing broader data architecture strategy.

What You’ll Do

Design & Evolve the Data Platform

Partner with engineering leadership to develop and evolve enterprise-scale data architecture across warehouses, lakes, and modern data platforms.

Develop logical and physical data models crafted to enable analytics and ML use cases, including dimensional models and optimized schemas.

Contribute to platform standards, reference architectures, and documentation across ingestion, transformation, governance, and analytics enablement.

Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Cloud Infrastructure teams to align with security, compliance, performance, and cost optimization guidelines.

Build Scalable Data Pipelines

Design, develop, and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from usage, clickstream, entitlement, cost, and support systems.

Build modular, reusable pipeline frameworks using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

Optimize data processing workflows for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency using distributed systems (e.g., Spark, Beam).

Work with Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers to operationalize data products and ML-ready datasets.

Strengthen Governance, Quality & Reliability

Design and implement scalable frameworks for managing and improving data integrity, including cataloging, lineage tracking, access controls, and automated validation processes to ensure trusted, production-grade data.

Establish and continuously improve reliability standards for data services, defining and tracking key SLOs such as freshness, pipeline success rates, and availability through proactive monitoring and alerting.

Maintain clear metadata, documentation, and data definitions to improve discoverability, enable self-service analytics, and support consistent operational excellence across the platform.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

8+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering, including building and operating production data platforms.

Experience contributing to data architecture decisions at the system or platform level.

Technical Expertise

Strong experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), including schema design and performance tuning.

Experience building production-grade pipelines using orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and distributed processing tools (Spark, Beam).

Deep understanding of ETL/ELT patterns, dimensional modeling, and analytics dataset design.

Experience implementing data governance and quality practices, including lineage, validation, and role-based access controls.

Proficiency in Scale or Java, plus experience Python & SQL

Experience working with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Experience defining data modeling standards, naming conventions, and data contracts.

Familiarity with event-driven and streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis).

Communication & Collaboration

Ability to translate business questions into scalable data models and platform capabilities.

Ability to clearly explain data and architectural concepts to diverse audiences.

Nice to Have

Experience in B2B SaaS, product analytics, or customer success environments.

Hands-on experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Great Expectations, Atlan, Collibra).

Exposure to MLOps concepts such as feature pipelines and training datasets.

Why Join This Team

Develop the architecture of a critical data platform used across Adobe.

Combine hands-on engineering with meaningful architectural influence.

Work with modern cloud and data technologies at enterprise scale.

Collaborate with experienced Data Science, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams.

If you’re passionate about building reliable, scalable data systems and influencing platform strategy, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

Join the AIF India Foundation team as an AIML Applied Engineer. In this role, you will develop and grow the AI Assistant and agentic core for Adobe Express. These components support Assistant experiences across multiple products. The job centers on server-side tasks. You will build and deploy AI/ML models and microservices, integrate external AI/ML providers, and keep AI features for Express users dependable and scalable.

What we offer

Contribute to Adobe Express and AI Assistant that serve millions of creators.

Build agentic and cross-product AI experiences with a strong engineering and research team.

Exposure to brand new AI/ML and cloud-native systems at scale.

Encouraging and unified setting at AIF India Foundation and Adobe.

What you'll do

AI Assistant development: Build, implement, and maintain server-side components of the Adobe Express AI Assistant (APIs, orchestration, state, tool use).

Agentic core: Contribute to the agentic core that enables cross-Assistant interaction and multi-product workflows (routing, context, handoffs).

Microservices: Develop and improve microservices that deliver AI Assistant and agentic functionalities to clients and other services.

Third-party AI/ML integration: Deploy and manage AI/ML models and APIs (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, specialised models); oversee authentication, retry mechanisms, fallback strategies, and balance cost versus latency.

Cloud & platform: Manage services within cloud environments (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure); use containers, orchestration, and platform tools for deployment and monitoring.

Reliability & observability: Integrate logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting; participate in on-call duties and incident management.

Collaboration: Work with product, build, and other engineering teams to ship features and improve AI quality and user experience.

Qualifications

Required

4–6 years of software engineering experience, including significant participation in applied AI/ML (model integration, deployment, or ML systems).

BS/BTech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

Strong background in server-side development with one or more of the following: JavaScript, Typescript, Python, Node.js; knowledge of REST/gRPC and asynchronous patterns.

Hands-on cloud experience (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure): compute, storage, networking, and managed services.

Solid data structures, algorithms, and system building; comfort with concurrency, scaling, and fault tolerance.

Experience with microservices: build, APIs, service boundaries, and deployment (e.g., containers, Kubernetes or similar).

Preferred

Experience with agentic systems: agents, tool use, planning, or multi-step reasoning in production.

Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., chat, completions, embeddings) and timely response handling at scale.

Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, A/B testing, canary releases, or feature stores.

Experience with observability (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and on-call for production services.

Experience in creative or build tools (e.g., Express, Creative Cloud) or conversational AI products.

Experience with AI/ML in production: incorporating or launching models (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, classifiers); understanding of latency, efficiency, and failure modes.

Experience integrating third-party AI/ML APIs or models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, or internal model services).
